TEXT_CLSBSM151_00295_SEQ_01: Forgemaster Brithael has no interest in matters of coin, but has nevertheless been ordered by Forgemaster H'naanza of the Armorers' Guild to find a way to increase exports to Gridania. This requires him to work closely with a trader named Faezahr, whom he seems loath to meet. Speak with the merchant outside the guild on the forgemaster's behalf.
TEXT_CLSBSM151_00295_SEQ_02: Faezahr wastes no time explaining how best to approach the Gridanians. However, before he will agree to negotiate on the guild's behalf, he requires samples of merchandise to present to potential buyers. Craft a bronze spatha and a spiked bronze labrys for the seasoned trader.
TEXT_CLSBSM151_00295_SEQ_03:
Having initially dismissed you as a mere errand , Faezahr is impressed by the quality of your craftsmanship, and readily agrees to present the weapons you made to his Gridanian contacts. 

※The next blacksmith quest will be available from Brithael upon reaching level 20.
TEXT_CLSBSM201_00296_SEQ_00: Forgemaster Brithael has important news he would like to share with you.
TEXT_CLSBSM201_00296_SEQ_01: It appears Faezahr has made progress towards securing new contracts for the guild, largely thanks to the samples you supplied. After congratulating himself on a job well done, Brithael assigns you your next task. Not only must you craft him an iron cross-pein hammer, but you must also attach a single materia to it. Should your knowledge of materia be lacking, he suggests you consult the goblin Mutamix in central Thanalan. Prepare the requested item and deliver it to the forgemaster.
TEXT_CLSBSM201_00296_SEQ_02:
Brithael has nothing but the highest praise for your hammer, confessing that he covets the tool for his own use. He goes on to suggest that your talents might prove key to promoting the guild's services to a wider audience─though what that would entail remains a subject for another day.

※The next blacksmith quest will be available from Brithael upon reaching level 25.
TEXT_CLSBSM251_00297_SEQ_00: Forgemaster Brithael has a special task for you.
TEXT_CLSBSM251_00297_SEQ_01: Hoping to win new contracts for the guild, Brithael has asked you to produce another sample. Craft a high-quality steel ingot and deliver it to Faezahr, who will once again handle negotiations.
TEXT_CLSBSM251_00297_SEQ_02:
Your expertly forged steel serves to elevate you further in Faezahr's esteem, but his opinion of Brithael remains as low as ever. Despite his scorn for the forgemaster, he pledges to recommend the guild's services to prospective clients.

※The next blacksmith quest will be available from Brithael upon reaching level 30.
TEXT_CLSBSM301_00298_SEQ_00: Forgemaster Brithael is eyeing you with an ominous grin on his face. It may be wise to inquire as to why.
TEXT_CLSBSM301_00298_SEQ_01: Apparently, your recent accomplishments have not gone unnoticed. According to Brithael, a wealthy Ul'dahn has requested you by name for a prestigious commission. Speak with Faezahr for more information.
TEXT_CLSBSM301_00298_SEQ_02: Although the commission represents a chance to win respect and renown, Faezahr warns you that failure is not an option. He then directs you to meet with the client's representative, a woman named Khuswyb. Summon your courage and address her directly.
TEXT_CLSBSM301_00298_SEQ_03: Khuswyb's master wishes to present his chief groundsman with a plumed iron hatchet in recognition of his loyal service. Needless to say, your client will settle for nothing short of perfection. Craft a plumed iron hatchet of unsurpassed quality and present it to Khuswyb.
TEXT_CLSBSM301_00298_SEQ_04: Your masterpiece has a profound impact on Khuswyb, and she accepts it with great fanfare. Relay the good news to Faezahr.
TEXT_CLSBSM301_00298_SEQ_05: Faezahr seems unsurprised by your success, though he is quick to note Khuswyb's enthusiastic endorsement. The trader then begrudgingly bids you bear word of your success to the forgemaster─though not before once again expressing his low opinion of the man. Return to Brithael and report all that has transpired.
TEXT_CLSBSM301_00298_SEQ_06:
Brushing aside Faezahr's comments, Brithael reminisces about the day you first joined the Blacksmiths' Guild, claiming that he always knew you had the potential for greatness. He then swears that as long as you remain loyal to the guild, you will be able to count on its unwavering support.

※The next blacksmith quest will be available from Brithael upon reaching level 35.
TEXT_CLSBSM351_00299_SEQ_00: Forgemaster Brithael has had to take on more smithing than he can anvil.
TEXT_CLSBSM351_00299_SEQ_01: Brithael's love of drink has caught up with him, as he appears to be suffering from a prolonged hangover. Unfortunately, this means that he is in no condition to fill Faezahr's latest commission. Offer your services to the merchant on behalf of the forgemaster.
TEXT_CLSBSM351_00299_SEQ_02: The steel bhuj Faezahr seeks to have forged is intended as a present for his favorite axeman, and he will accept nothing less than the finest quality. Craft the item to the best of your ability and present it to Faezahr for inspection.
TEXT_CLSBSM351_00299_SEQ_03:
Your bhuj elicits an uncharacteristic expression of bloodlust from Faezahr, though he manages to quickly regain his composure. Once again impressed with your fine display of craftsmanship, the merchant hints that he will have more work for you in future.

※The next blacksmith quest will be available from Brithael upon reaching level 40.
TEXT_CLSBSM401_00300_SEQ_00: Forgemaster Brithael needs an able blacksmith to set an example.
TEXT_CLSBSM401_00300_SEQ_01: As your reputation continues to grow, it seems even your guildmates have come to covet your wares. However, the forgemaster does not expect you to furnish your guildmates with the tools they seek; rather, he would have you craft a single wrapped crowsbeak hammer of impeccable quality to serve as a model for the other smiths. When it is ready, deliver it to Brithael for inspection.
TEXT_CLSBSM401_00300_SEQ_02:
Though Brithael briefly jests that your hammer might serve to discourage your forgemates from pursuing their craft, it is clear that he hopes your work will instead inspire others to follow in your footsteps and become better blacksmiths. Only time will tell if your forgemates will rise to the challenge.

※The next blacksmith quest will be available from Brithael upon reaching level 45.
TEXT_CLSBSM451_00301_SEQ_00: Forgemaster Brithael is delighted to see you.
TEXT_CLSBSM451_00301_SEQ_01: Everyone at the Blacksmiths' Guild is in high spirits of late, and Brithael is no exception. The forgemaster even managed to enjoy the company of Faezahr for a change, who over drinks with Brithael spoke of his latest obsession: a young female gladiator, whom he has a mind to lavish with gifts. Precisely what those gifts are to be remains to be seen, but what is clear is that Faezahr means to ask you to craft them.
TEXT_CLSBSM451_00301_SEQ_02: Faezahr bids you craft a pair of cobalt knuckles, a buccaneer's bardiche, and a cobalt shamshir worthy of his gladiator muse, Muriel. Naturally, it will be necessary for him to first inspect and approve of the weapons prior to delivery. Craft the items to the best of your ability and present them to Faezahr when finished.
TEXT_CLSBSM451_00301_SEQ_03: The merchant waxes poetic as he evaluates your weapons, before judging them fit for his warrior goddess. Believing it only proper for Muriel to meet the  who made such splendid wares, Faezahr bids you deliver his gifts to Muriel, who can be found aboard the Astalicia.
TEXT_CLSBSM451_00301_SEQ_04:
Muriel treasures the gifts you have brought, and seems overjoyed to have made your acquaintance─so overjoyed, in fact, that you cannot help but question the sincerity of her words. In any case, the commission is complete; should Faezahr be unsatisfied with the result, the fault will not lie with you.

※The next blacksmith quest will be available from Brithael upon reaching level 50.
TEXT_CLSBSM501_00302_SEQ_00: Forgemaster Brithael has a special commission only you can handle.
TEXT_CLSBSM501_00302_SEQ_01: The guild is busier than ever due to your numerous past efforts. Countless customers have requested you by name, but Brithael has only seen fit to oblige a single one. Speak with Faezahr to learn the details of this special commission.
TEXT_CLSBSM501_00302_SEQ_02: A former champion of the Coliseum has come all the way from Gridania to speak with you in person. You will find the client waiting for you on the platform just below the Drowning Wench, where you may speak in private.
TEXT_CLSBSM501_00302_SEQ_03: The client, who chose not to divulge her name, wishes to furnish a struggling gladiator with a weapon that befits his skill and experience. This gladiator, known as the Bronze Bull, is apparently another former champion who has chosen to fight under a different name. You are to craft a quality cobalt winglet, meld to it a savage might materia of the third grade, and deliver the finished product to Faezahr.
TEXT_CLSBSM501_00302_SEQ_04: Upon confirming that your sword satisfies the client's requirements, Faezahr summons the Bronze Bull to collect the weapon in person, while the anonymous client surreptitiously listens. The gladiator is at first puzzled by the gesture, unable to understand the motives of your patron. However, when Faezahr delivers a cryptic message, the Bronze Bull immediately identifies your client as the Hellfire Phoenix, who he thought had perished in the Calamity years ago. He accepts the sword, proclaiming that he will one day stand atop the Coliseum and do it justice, and leaves without meeting your client. Speak with her and see if these events transpired as she desired.
TEXT_CLSBSM501_00302_SEQ_05: Your client explains that her desire to remain distant from the Coliseum and its affairs drove her to deliver the sword in this manner. Nevertheless, she could not resist using Greinfarr's words to reveal her identity to the former champion. Having entrusted your payment to the forgemaster, she bids you return to him to receive it.
TEXT_CLSBSM501_00302_SEQ_06:
Brithael reflects on how you single-handedly changed the guild's fortunes, stating that the impact of your deeds will be felt for years to come. With a glint in his eye and a smile on his face, he calls you one of the best blacksmiths he has ever known.

※The next blacksmith quest will be available from Brithael once you have completed the main scenario quest “Before the Dawn.”
TEXT_CLSEXC011_00310_SEQ_00: Blauthota wishes you to reaffirm your desire to join the Marauders' Guild.
TEXT_CLSEXC011_00310_SEQ_01: Blauthota bids you speak with Axemaster Wyrnzoen, whose approval you must obtain if you wish to join the guild.
TEXT_CLSEXC011_00310_SEQ_02: Though somewhat grim of word and demeanor, Axemaster Wyrnzoen nevertheless welcomes you to the Marauders' Guild. Equip the weathered war axe that symbolizes your initiation and speak with the stern Roegadyn once more.
TEXT_CLSEXC020_00311_SEQ_00: Blauthota wishes you to reaffirm your desire to join the Marauders' Guild.
TEXT_CLSEXC020_00311_SEQ_01: Blauthota bids you speak with Axemaster Wyrnzoen, whose approval you must obtain if you wish to join the guild.
TEXT_CLSEXC020_00311_SEQ_02: Though somewhat grim of word and demeanor, Axemaster Wyrnzoen nevertheless welcomes you to the Marauders' Guild. As a new student of the axe, you are bid by the hulking Roegadyn to waste no time in testing the edge of your chosen weapon in combat. Head to the outskirts of Limsa Lominsa and slay three lost lambs, three wharf rats, and three little ladybugs.
TEXT_CLSEXC020_00311_SEQ_03: You have slain the specified creatures. Return to the Marauders' Guild and report to Axemaster Wyrnzoen.
TEXT_CLSEXC020_00311_SEQ_04:
You return to the guild with a greater awareness of your weapon's brutal potential. To fully realize that potential, however, Wyrnzoen encourages you to hone your skill and strength with relentless determination.

※The next marauder quest will be available from Wyrnzoen upon reaching level 5.
TEXT_CLSEXC021_00312_SEQ_00: Axemaster Wyrnzoen would have you test the edge of your new axe in combat.
TEXT_CLSEXC021_00312_SEQ_01: As a new student of the axe, you are bid by the hulking Roegadyn to waste no time in testing the edge of your chosen weapon in combat. Head to the outskirts of Limsa Lominsa and slay three lost lambs, three wharf rats, and three little ladybugs.
TEXT_CLSEXC021_00312_SEQ_02: You have slain the specified creatures. Return to the Marauders' Guild and report to Axemaster Wyrnzoen.
TEXT_CLSEXC021_00312_SEQ_03:
You return to the guild with a greater awareness of your weapon's brutal potential. To fully realize that potential, however, Wyrnzoen encourages you to hone your skill and strength with relentless determination.

※The next marauder quest will be available from Wyrnzoen upon reaching level 5.
TEXT_CLSEXC050_00313_SEQ_00: Axemaster Wyrnzoen wishes you to experience a traditional marauder training method.
TEXT_CLSEXC050_00313_SEQ_01: Wyrnzoen has instructed you to speak with a fellow marauder to learn the nature of the training you are to undertake. Find Broenbhar in the practice area downstairs.
TEXT_CLSEXC050_00313_SEQ_02: Broenbhar explains that marauders develop strength and precision by splitting rocks with their axes. To try your hand at this traditional training method, head out to the Rogue River in middle La Noscea and speak with Rhotgeim.
TEXT_CLSEXC050_00313_SEQ_03: Rhotgeim bids you shatter the stones she has prepared. Destroy the solid rocks on the bank of the river using the Heavy Swing technique.
TEXT_CLSEXC050_00313_SEQ_04: You have shattered three solid rocks. Report to the waiting Rhotgeim.
TEXT_CLSEXC050_00313_SEQ_05: Rhotgeim bids you shatter yet more rocks. Destroy the solid rocks on the bank of the river with your Heavy Swing ability.
TEXT_CLSEXC050_00313_SEQ_06: You have shattered yet another three solid rocks. Report to the waiting Rhotgeim.
TEXT_CLSEXC050_00313_SEQ_07: Rhotgeim seems pleased with your rock-shattering ability. Return to the Marauders' Guild and report to Axemaster Wyrnzoen.
TEXT_CLSEXC050_00313_SEQ_08: Upon returning to the guild, you learn that Axemaster Wyrnzoen has assigned you to respond to an urgent request from the Red Rooster Stead─a duty that involves slaying murderous megalocrabs. Solkwyb, a veteran conjurer, will aid you in this task. Seek her out within the guild before you depart for lower La Noscea.
TEXT_CLSEXC050_00313_SEQ_09: You speak with the conjurer, Solkwyb, and learn more of the duty that lies ahead. Meet her at the megalocrab nest near the Mourning Widow in lower La Noscea.
TEXT_CLSEXC050_00313_SEQ_10: As you are searching through the megalocrab nest, you are approached by a desperate old man by the name of Neddard. Rush to the aid of his grandson, Sighard, before the boy is slain by the rampaging crustaceans.
TEXT_CLSEXC050_00313_SEQ_11: You have slain the megalocrabs and rescued Neddard's grandson from a grisly fate. After thanking you for saving him, Sighard pleads with you to avenge his parents by slaying the fearsome creature responsible for their deaths. Return to the Marauders' Guild and report the situation to Axemaster Wyrnzoen.
TEXT_CLSEXC050_00313_SEQ_12:
You report the outcome of your duty to Axemaster Wyrnzoen. The veteran marauder, however, already appears to have knowledge of the creature that slew Sighard's parents. He commends your desire to seek vengeance on the boy's behalf, but warns that you are currently no match for this territorial monstrosity. Nurture your rage and hone your skills before attempting to grant Sighard's fervent wish.

※The next marauder quest will be available from Wyrnzoen upon reaching level 10.
TEXT_CLSEXC100_00314_SEQ_00: Wyrnzoen wishes to speak with you regarding your ongoing training.
TEXT_CLSEXC100_00314_SEQ_01: Wyrnzoen has taken a personal interest in preparing you to take vengeance against Kujata, the beast responsible for slaying Sighard's parents. Focus your rage, and slay the galagos found near Blind Iron Mines.
TEXT_CLSEXC100_00314_SEQ_02: You have slain the specified creatures. Return to the Marauders' Guild and report to Axemaster Wyrnzoen.
TEXT_CLSEXC100_00314_SEQ_03: After returning to Axemaster Wyrnzoen, you learn that Kujata has been on a destructive rampage through the lands near Tiller's Rest. Find the overturned wain in middle La Noscea, and slay the plainstriders that seek to devour the exposed cargo of foodstuffs.
TEXT_CLSEXC100_00314_SEQ_04: You have defeated the plainstriders. Return to the Marauders' Guild and report to Axemaster Wyrnzoen.
TEXT_CLSEXC100_00314_SEQ_05:
Though you have successfully defended the cargo of produce from the voracious plainstriders, you learn that such incidents will continue so long as Kujata is allowed to rampage unchecked. To fully prepare yourself to defeat the so-called Stampeding Mountain, you must heed Wyrnzoen's advice and commit yourself to your training.

※The next marauder quest will be available from Wyrnzoen upon reaching level 15.
TEXT_CLSEXC101_00315_SEQ_00: Wyrnzoen wishes to speak with you regarding your ongoing training.
TEXT_CLSEXC101_00315_SEQ_01: Wyrnzoen has taken a personal interest in preparing you to take vengeance against Kujata, the beast responsible for slaying Sighard's parents. Focus your rage, and slay the galagos found near Blind Iron Mines.
TEXT_CLSEXC101_00315_SEQ_02: You have slain the specified creatures. Return to the Marauders' Guild and report to Axemaster Wyrnzoen.
TEXT_CLSEXC101_00315_SEQ_03: After returning to Axemaster Wyrnzoen, you learn that Kujata has been on a destructive rampage through the lands near Tiller's Rest. Find the overturned wain in middle La Noscea, and slay the plainstriders that seek to devour the exposed cargo of foodstuffs.
TEXT_CLSEXC101_00315_SEQ_04: You have defeated the plainstriders. Return to the Marauders' Guild and report to Axemaster Wyrnzoen.
TEXT_CLSEXC101_00315_SEQ_05:
Though you have successfully defended the cargo of produce from the voracious plainstriders, you learn that such incidents will continue so long as Kujata is allowed to rampage unchecked. To fully prepare yourself to defeat the so-called Stampeding Mountain, you must heed Wyrnzoen's advice and commit yourself to your training.

※The next marauder quest will be available from Wyrnzoen upon reaching level 15.
TEXT_CLSEXC150_00316_SEQ_00: Axemaster Wyrnzoen has a new task for you to undertake.
TEXT_CLSEXC150_00316_SEQ_01: A formidable creature threatening the safety of western La Noscean inhabitants is to be the next challenge to fall to your axe. Make your way to Aleport, and speak with Wyrnzoen's acquaintance Reynfred to learn more of this prowling menace.
TEXT_CLSEXC150_00316_SEQ_02: You are to find a likely spot northwest of Aleport in which to do battle. Whistle to lure out Patripatan, then slay the dangerous creature.
TEXT_CLSEXC150_00316_SEQ_03: You have slain Patripatan. Return to the Marauders' Guild and report to Axemaster Wyrnzoen.
TEXT_CLSEXC150_00316_SEQ_04: Pleased with the successful completion of your task, Wyrnzoen bids you attempt another traditional marauder training exercise. Speak with Skapfghim on the bank of the Agelyss River in middle La Noscea, and try your hand at this new trial.
TEXT_CLSEXC150_00316_SEQ_05: Skapfghim draws your attention to a great rock on the bank of the Agelyss River. Destroy the unmovable boulder using a Heavy Swing.
TEXT_CLSEXC150_00316_SEQ_06: You have successfully shattered the boulder. Report to Skapfghim on the bank of the Agelyss River.
TEXT_CLSEXC150_00316_SEQ_07: Skapfghim seems satisfied with your boulder-breaking axe swing. Return to the Marauders' Guild and report to Axemaster Wyrnzoen.
TEXT_CLSEXC150_00316_SEQ_08:
In recognition of your feat of strength, Wyrnzoen teaches you a technique that allows you to strike enemies from a distance. Return to your training, and explore the tactical possibilities afforded you by this new ability.

※The next marauder quest will be available from Wyrnzoen upon reaching level 20.
TEXT_CLSEXC200_00317_SEQ_00: Axemaster Wyrnzoen requires your assistance with a troubling development.
TEXT_CLSEXC200_00317_SEQ_01: Wyrnzoen informs you that Sighard, the boy whose parents were killed by Kujata, has gone missing. In light of your previous experiences, the axemaster has nominated you to find the wayward child. Seek out Solkwyb at the Bismarck, and discuss how you should best proceed with the search.
TEXT_CLSEXC200_00317_SEQ_02: Solkwyb suggests that you first hear the details of Sighard's disappearance directly from the boy's grandfather. Make your way to the Red Rooster Stead in lower La Noscea and speak with Neddard.
TEXT_CLSEXC200_00317_SEQ_03: After listening to Neddard's tale, you learn that Sighard has likely run off towards Aleport in search of Kujata. Speak with Solkwyb to plan your next move.
TEXT_CLSEXC200_00317_SEQ_04: Solkwyb mentions an acquaintance in Aleport who might have more information on Sighard's whereabouts. Head to the coastal settlement in western La Noscea, and question the gate guard Pfarstym.
TEXT_CLSEXC200_00317_SEQ_05: Pfarstym tells you that he saw a boy matching Sighard's description heading off to the north. Fearing for the child's safety, he urges you to make haste before a roaming pack of predators finds Sighard first. Search the area around Aleport, and attempt to pick up the boy's trail.
TEXT_CLSEXC200_00317_SEQ_06: You have managed to discover some of Sighard's belongings, but the boy himself is nowhere to be seen. Catch up to Solkwyb, and see if her search has proven more fruitful.
TEXT_CLSEXC200_00317_SEQ_07: Along with Solkwyb, and the sudden arrival of Wyrnzoen, you manage to rescue Sighard from a vicious pack of ravenous jackals. Return to the Red Rooster Stead and speak with the waiting Neddard.
TEXT_CLSEXC200_00317_SEQ_08: Upon hearing your account of the rescue, Neddard apologizes for his grandson's foolhardy actions. There appears to be little more you can do for Sighard now except allow him time to recover from his injuries. Return to the Marauders' Guild and discuss with Wyrnzoen what you might best be doing.
TEXT_CLSEXC200_00317_SEQ_09:
Wyrnzoen expresses sympathy for Sighard's impatience, and directs you to return to your training. The axemaster once again vows to shape you into a weapon deadly enough to fell even the mighty Kujata.

※The next marauder quest will be available from Wyrnzoen upon reaching level 25.
TEXT_CLSEXC250_00318_SEQ_00: Axemaster Wyrnzoen wishes to set for you a trial that will hone your strength and skill to ever greater heights.
TEXT_CLSEXC250_00318_SEQ_01: After your eye-opening encounter with the pack jackals, the axemaster deems that, without further training, your chances against Kujata remain slim. He has thus devised a new trial, designed to unleash your deepest reserves of destructive power. Head to the Bismarck and speak with Solkwyb to learn what you must do.
TEXT_CLSEXC250_00318_SEQ_02: It appears that Solkwyb will once again accompany you during your training. Prepare yourself for what promises to be a grueling trial before seeking out the conjurer on the Salt Strand in lower La Noscea.
TEXT_CLSEXC250_00318_SEQ_03: At first, your trial seems absurdly simple. But even as you defeat the first wave of adversaries in the shadow of the Salt Strand's ominous formations, you next find yourself attacked by an eerily familiar group of masked men. After swinging your axe with grim determination, you eventually triumph over the “mysterious” warriors, and they quit the field in deference to your superior skill. Return to the Marauders' Guild and report this turn of events to Axemaster Wyrnzoen.
TEXT_CLSEXC250_00318_SEQ_04:
Setting the matter of strange masked men aside, Wyrnzoen instead focuses on praising your display of unrivaled power. You are now recognized as the exemplar of marauder strength, and the entire guild stands ready to support you in your quest to slay the monstrous Kujata. Keep your axe blade keen and your skills sharp as you await the next sighting of the murderous aurochs. The time has come for the beast to die.

※The next marauder quest will be available from Wyrnzoen upon reaching level 30.
TEXT_CLSEXC300_00319_SEQ_00: Axemaster Wyrnzoen appears to have some urgent news for you.
TEXT_CLSEXC300_00319_SEQ_01: Wyrnzoen informs you that Kujata has been spotted in lower La Noscea. Before seeking to do battle with the rampaging beast, the axemaster bids you first visit Sighard at the Red Rooster Stead.
TEXT_CLSEXC300_00319_SEQ_02: Sighard has once again begged you to slay the beast responsible for the death of his parents. It seems, however, that you will not be alone in the task. Speak with Solkwyb and Broenbhar before leaving the Stead, and enlist their aid for the coming battle.
TEXT_CLSEXC300_00319_SEQ_03: Solkwyb and Broenbhar are both eager to stand at your side as you seek to bring down the Stampeding Mountain. Follow Broenbhar's advice, and track down Kujata by following the beast's trail of destruction.
TEXT_CLSEXC300_00319_SEQ_04: You have found the broken remnants of a pot, but Kujata is nowhere to be seen. Continue following the trail left by him and his pack of rapacious scavengers.
TEXT_CLSEXC300_00319_SEQ_05: You have discovered the shattered pieces of a barrel on the side of the road, but have yet to spot Kujata. Continue following the trail of destruction left behind by the monster and his pack.
TEXT_CLSEXC300_00319_SEQ_06: You have stumbled upon the splintered remains of a crate, but Kujata himself appears to have since moved on. Continue your search for the vile beast and the ravenous creatures that follow him.
TEXT_CLSEXC300_00319_SEQ_07: You have finally caught up with Kujata and ended the murderous aurochs' terrible rampage. Wyrnzoen appears with Sighard and Neddard in tow, just in time to help celebrate your hard-won victory. Sighard is overcome with gratitude. Now that you have freed the boy from his burden of vengeance, he has decided to pursue the path of a hero. All that remains is to speak with your waiting colleagues.
TEXT_CLSEXC300_00319_SEQ_08: Wyrnzoen, Solkwyb, and Broenbhar all applaud the mighty deed you have accomplished. Return to Limsa Lominsa, and speak with the axemaster once more back at the guild.
TEXT_CLSEXC300_00319_SEQ_09: Wyrnzoen, having imparted to you all the knowledge of axecraft that he possesses, bids you venture beyond the teachings of the guild. And once you have attained a new peak of marauder perfection, he hopes you will return to share your discoveries. The world─with all its wondrous and deadly challenges─is yours to explore.
TEXT_CLSTHM011_00344_SEQ_00: Yayake wishes you to reaffirm your desire to join the Thaumaturges' Guild.
TEXT_CLSTHM011_00344_SEQ_01: Yayake has bid you seek out the eldest of five brothers, thaumaturge siblings who each bear the title of guildmaster. Speak with Cocobygo in the inner sanctum of the Thaumaturges' Guild.
TEXT_CLSTHM011_00344_SEQ_02: After some confusion as to which brother you should be speaking to, you are eventually accepted into the Thaumaturges' Guild. Equip your new scepter and speak with Cocobuki once more.
TEXT_CLSTHM020_00345_SEQ_00: Yayake wishes you to reaffirm your desire to join the Thaumaturges' Guild.
TEXT_CLSTHM020_00345_SEQ_01: Yayake has bid you seek out the eldest of five brothers, thaumaturge siblings who each bear the title of guildmaster. Speak with Cocobygo in the inner sanctum of the Thaumaturges' Guild.
TEXT_CLSTHM020_00345_SEQ_02: Cocobuki has set you a trial to test the limits of your aptitude for channeling thaumaturgy. Exercise your sorcerous might and slay three huge hornets, three star marmots, and three snapping shrews.
TEXT_CLSTHM020_00345_SEQ_03: You have slain the specified creatures. Return to the Thaumaturges' Guild and report to Cocobuki.
TEXT_CLSTHM020_00345_SEQ_04:
Cocobuki has formally accepted you into the ranks of the Thaumaturges' Guild. Continue to train and expand your reserves of magical endurance that you might further explore the yawning abyss of thaumaturgy's mysteries.

※The next thaumaturge quest will be available from Cocobuki upon reaching level 5.
TEXT_CLSTHM021_00346_SEQ_00: Guildmaster Cocobuki wishes to test the limits of your thaumaturgical aptitude.
TEXT_CLSTHM021_00346_SEQ_01: Cocobuki has set you a trial to test the limits of your aptitude for channeling thaumaturgy. Exercise your sorcerous might and slay three huge hornets, three star marmots, and three snapping shrews.
TEXT_CLSTHM021_00346_SEQ_02: You have slain the specified creatures. Return to the Thaumaturges' Guild and report to Cocobuki.
TEXT_CLSTHM021_00346_SEQ_03:
Cocobuki has formally accepted you into the ranks of the Thaumaturges' Guild. Continue to train and expand your reserves of magical endurance that you might further explore the yawning abyss of thaumaturgy's mysteries.

※The next thaumaturge quest will be available from Cocobuki upon reaching level 5.
TEXT_CLSTHM050_00347_SEQ_00: Guildmaster Cocobuki wishes to draw you further into the abyss of thaumaturgy's secrets.
TEXT_CLSTHM050_00347_SEQ_01: Listen to Guildmaster Cocobygo's lesson taken from “The Threat of Intimacy,” the first chapter from Zozomaya's lauded guide Thaumaturgy: The Yawning Abyss.
TEXT_CLSTHM050_00347_SEQ_02: The passage recited by Cocobygo warns that a thaumaturge would do well to keep  enemies at a distance. To put this teaching into practice, take the dried fish given to you and set it down in the field located to the northeast of the Silver Bazaar. Its presence should lure out an unsuspecting vulture upon which you can unleash thaumaturgical devastation.
TEXT_CLSTHM050_00347_SEQ_03: You have placed the dried fish. Find an area from which you can comfortably view the fish and wait for a circling vulture to appear. When it does, slay the scavenger while still at range.
TEXT_CLSTHM050_00347_SEQ_04: You have slain the vulture. Take a slice of the vulture's breast meat to Fafafono in the nearby Silver Bazaar.
TEXT_CLSTHM050_00347_SEQ_05: Fafafono seems pleased by your offering of the lightly charred bird meat. Return to the Thaumaturges' Guild and report your success to Cocobygo.
TEXT_CLSTHM050_00347_SEQ_06:
Though you have but recently learned firsthand the merits of engaging in conflicts from a distance, you are unfortunately subjected to a close-range quarrel between the guildmasters and their youngest brother, Cocobusi. It seems the infuriated sibling lacks the aptitude for thaumaturgy and resents his siblings for their refusal to accept him for training. Guildmaster Cocobuki bids you pay the incident no mind and return to your study of thaumaturgical mysteries.

※The next thaumaturge quest will be available from Cocobuki upon reaching level 10.
TEXT_CLSTHM100_00348_SEQ_00: Guildmaster Cocobuki wishes you to learn from the second chapter of Thaumaturgy: The Yawning Abyss.
TEXT_CLSTHM100_00348_SEQ_01: Listen to Cocobani, the third-eldest brother, as he instructs you from the chapter entitled “The Threat of Paucity.”
TEXT_CLSTHM100_00348_SEQ_02: Keeping your state of aetheric balance in mind, head to Black Brush and slay eight efts.
TEXT_CLSTHM100_00348_SEQ_03: You have slain the efts. Return to the Thaumaturges' Guild and report to Cocobani.
TEXT_CLSTHM100_00348_SEQ_04: It appears that an Amalj'aa raiding party has attacked a merchant caravan and made off with a crate of ether. Make your way to the south of Drybone, and investigate the beastmen's armored war transport. Before retrieving the stolen cargo, however, you are to defeat the Amalj'aa and obtain bottles of their blood.
TEXT_CLSTHM100_00348_SEQ_05: You have slain the threatening Amalj'aa and satisfied Cocobuki's additional request. Investigate the armored war transport once more, and retrieve the crate of ether.
TEXT_CLSTHM100_00348_SEQ_06: You have reclaimed the crate of ether. Return to the Thaumaturges' Guild and report to Cocobani.
TEXT_CLSTHM100_00348_SEQ_07: Report to Cocobuki and hear what the guildmaster has to say.
TEXT_CLSTHM100_00348_SEQ_08:
Cocobani has taught you the importance of maintaining a steady flow of aetheric energy, be it through managing your state of balance, or replenishing your arcane reserves with a vial of precious ether. Keep these lessons in mind as you return to your journey into the stygian depths of thaumaturgy.

※The next thaumaturge quest will be available from Cocobuki upon reaching level 15.
TEXT_CLSTHM101_00349_SEQ_00: Guildmaster Cocobuki wishes you to learn from the second chapter of Thaumaturgy: The Yawning Abyss.
TEXT_CLSTHM101_00349_SEQ_01: Listen to Cocobani, the third-eldest brother, as he instructs you from the chapter entitled “The Threat of Paucity.”
TEXT_CLSTHM101_00349_SEQ_02: Keeping your state of aetheric balance in mind, head to Black Brush and slay eight efts.
TEXT_CLSTHM101_00349_SEQ_03: You have slain the efts. Return to the Thaumaturges' Guild and report to Cocobani.
TEXT_CLSTHM101_00349_SEQ_04: It appears that an Amalj'aa raiding party has attacked a merchant caravan and made off with a crate of ether. Make your way to the south of Drybone, and investigate the beastmen's armored war transport. Before retrieving the stolen cargo, however, you are to defeat the Amalj'aa and obtain bottles of their blood.
TEXT_CLSTHM101_00349_SEQ_05: You have slain the threatening Amalj'aa and satisfied Cocobuki's additional request. Investigate the armored war transport once more, and retrieve the crate of ether.
TEXT_CLSTHM101_00349_SEQ_06: You have reclaimed the crate of ether. Return to the Thaumaturges' Guild and report to Cocobani.
TEXT_CLSTHM101_00349_SEQ_07:
Cocobani has taught you the importance of maintaining a steady flow of aetheric energy, be it through managing your state of balance, or replenishing your arcane reserves with a vial of precious ether. Keep these lessons in mind as you return to your journey into the stygian depths of thaumaturgy.

※The next thaumaturge quest will be available from Cocobuki upon reaching level 15.
TEXT_CLSTHM150_00350_SEQ_00: Guildmaster Cocobuki urges you ever deeper into the yawning abyss of thaumaturgy.
TEXT_CLSTHM150_00350_SEQ_01: Listen to Cocobezi as he instructs you from the chapter entitled “The Threat of Superiority.”
TEXT_CLSTHM150_00350_SEQ_02: A trio of furious merchants have come to demand recompense for the crate of ether consumed by the guildmaster siblings. Elicit the traders' sympathy by crying, and convince them to leave empty-handed.
TEXT_CLSTHM150_00350_SEQ_03: Your tears have convinced the merchants to leave without pressing their case for repayment. Report your success to Cocobezi.
TEXT_CLSTHM150_00350_SEQ_04: You have been assigned a trial that requires you to destroy the cursed artifact known as Mormo's urn. Keeping in mind how effective a well-timed Sleep spell can be, track down and defeat the Alacran thieves who have stolen the urn and are now traveling in the southeast of Drybone.
TEXT_CLSTHM150_00350_SEQ_05: You have defeated the Alacran thieves and destroyed Mormo's urn. Return to the Thaumaturges' Guild and report to Cocobezi.
TEXT_CLSTHM150_00350_SEQ_06:
Cocobuki is impressed with your control and skill in the midst of an unexpected situation. You are, however, concerned with the change that has come over Cocobusi after the unusual events of your trial. Endeavor to keep your lessons fresh in your mind as you return to your training in thaumaturgy.

※The next thaumaturge quest will be available from Cocobuki upon reaching level 20.
TEXT_CLSTHM200_00351_SEQ_00: Guildmaster Cocobuki wishes you to learn from the next chapter of Thaumaturgy: The Yawning Abyss.
TEXT_CLSTHM200_00351_SEQ_01: Listen to Cocoboha, the second-youngest brother, as he instructs you from the chapter entitled “The Threat of Perplexity.”
TEXT_CLSTHM200_00351_SEQ_02: You learn of a recent spate of murders perpetrated by a villain known only as the “Mageslayer.” The killer appears to be exclusively targeting thaumaturges, draining them of their aetheric vitality. Head to Nophica's Wells in western Thanalan, and aid Cocobusi in his attempt to track down this seemingly insatiable predator.
TEXT_CLSTHM200_00351_SEQ_03: Cocobusi has bid you examine the remains of the slain thaumaturges. Head into the nearby stream, and see what evidence of the killer can be found.
TEXT_CLSTHM200_00351_SEQ_04: You have recovered a bloody scepter, a shredded tome, and a bloody bracelet from the corpses of the unfortunate mages. Return to Cocobusi, and see what he can determine from the sullied objects.
TEXT_CLSTHM200_00351_SEQ_05: After noting the freshness of the blood staining the items you recovered, Cocobusi believes the killer may yet be lurking nearby. Head back into the stream, and draw out the Mageslayer by using yourself as bait. You nervously hope that the Roegadyn warrior does, indeed, stand ready to leap into the fray!
TEXT_CLSTHM200_00351_SEQ_06: With the help of the stalwart swordsman, you have succeeded in defeating the trio of imps. Report your success to Cocobusi.
TEXT_CLSTHM200_00351_SEQ_07: Cocobusi laments that a single imp managed to escape the scene of slaughter. Search for the cowardly voidsent in the shaded outcropping to the southeast, and bring your trial to a satisfying conclusion.
TEXT_CLSTHM200_00351_SEQ_08: The true identity of the Mageslayer has been revealed. Return to the Thaumaturges' Guild and report to Cocoboha.
TEXT_CLSTHM200_00351_SEQ_09: Cocoboha, seemingly unaware of his younger sibling's possession, declares that with the successful completion of this lesson's trial, your training with the Yawning Abyss is now at an end. Speak with Cocobuki, and learn what is to be done about Cocobusi.
TEXT_CLSTHM200_00351_SEQ_10:
Cocobuki appears shaken and dismayed by his confrontation with the voidsent-possessed Cocobusi. He asks that you leave him in peace for a time, that he might consider his next course of action.

※The next thaumaturge quest will be available from Cocobygo upon reaching level 25.
TEXT_CLSTHM250_00352_SEQ_00: Guildmaster Cocobygo wishes to enlist your assistance.
TEXT_CLSTHM250_00352_SEQ_01: Cocobygo is disturbed by his eldest sibling's uncharacteristic indecision. Speak with Cocobuki, and see what might be done to aid the hesitant thaumaturge in taking a definitive course of action.
TEXT_CLSTHM250_00352_SEQ_02: The scholars who originally requested the destruction of Mormo's urn have returned from their expedition into the ruins of Sil'dih. Seek out the three voidmaths in Camp Drybone, and ask for their chapters of the Book of Mormo.
TEXT_CLSTHM250_00352_SEQ_03: You have collected the three chapters of the Book of Mormo. Deliver the completed tome to Cocobuki at the Thaumaturges' Guild.
TEXT_CLSTHM250_00352_SEQ_04: Upon handing the Book of Mormo to Cocobuki, he reads several key excerpts to you out loud. The scholars' work seems to have given him an idea on how to handle his voidsent-possessed brother. Returning the book back to you, Cocobuki requests you show its contents to Cocobygo.
TEXT_CLSTHM250_00352_SEQ_05: Cocobuki bids you undertake the trial depicted in the true final chapter of the Yawning Abyss, and prove to his siblings that a brave mage is not necessarily a dead mage. When you are prepared to demonstrate the heretofore hidden chapter's lesson, proceed into the hallowed hall of Thal's Respite in eastern Thanalan, and speak with Cocobuki.
TEXT_CLSTHM250_00352_SEQ_06: You have completed the terrible and deadly trial of the hidden chapter. Return to the Thaumaturges' Guild and speak with Cocobuki.
TEXT_CLSTHM250_00352_SEQ_07:
With the horrors of the hidden chapter safely vanquished, you have inspired the guildmaster siblings to greater heights of thaumaturgy. Return to your studies, and prepare for the coming confrontation with Mormo herself.

※The next thaumaturge quest will be available from Cocobuki upon reaching level 30.
TEXT_CLSTHM300_00353_SEQ_00: Guildmaster Cocobuki wishes to enlist your aid in tracking down Cocobusi.
TEXT_CLSTHM300_00353_SEQ_01: Cocobusi has been spotted in the vicinity of Vesper Bay. Take the descriptions that Cocobuki has written of the voidsent-possessed Lalafell, and hand them out to a few Vesper Bay locals.
TEXT_CLSTHM300_00353_SEQ_02: Your investigations have revealed that Cocobusi is in the company of a marauder and a thaumaturge. You also learn that the succubus was seen leaving a local alehouse with several smitten maidens. Report your findings to Cocobuki, who is waiting at the center of Vesper Bay.
TEXT_CLSTHM300_00353_SEQ_03: After explaining Mormo's grim purpose for the women she has seduced, Cocobuki bids you seek out the Lominsan adventurers said to be accompanying the treacherous voidsent. Begin your search to the north of Vesper Bay.
TEXT_CLSTHM300_00353_SEQ_04: You have stumbled across one of the missing adventurers, and defeated an imp's attempted ambush. Speak with the wounded marauder to find out where Cocobusi may be heading.
TEXT_CLSTHM300_00353_SEQ_05: You learn from the marauder that his thaumaturge companion has been dragged further north, into the caverns of Moondrip. Locate Cocobuki directly outside the cave, and speak with him when you are ready to put an end to the voidsent's murderous villainy.
TEXT_CLSTHM300_00353_SEQ_06: With the aid of the four fearful yet determined brothers, you have succeeded in defeating the terrible Mormo. Return to the Thaumaturges' Guild and speak with Cocobuki.
TEXT_CLSTHM300_00353_SEQ_07: Cocobuki attributes his family's renewed perspective on their sorcerous discipline to your valiant and masterful displays of magecraft. It is with great eagerness that the emboldened guildmaster awaits tales of your future endeavors in thaumaturgy.
TEXT_CLSLNC005_00438_SEQ_00: Guildmaster Ywain wants you to learn from other masters of the lancer's art.
TEXT_CLSLNC005_00438_SEQ_01: Ywain would send you to train under the tutelage of three renowned lancers. The first of these is a man named Matheomi, who can be found at Amarissaix's Spire in the East Shroud.
TEXT_CLSLNC005_00438_SEQ_02: Matheomi has set you a trial. Sprinkle the contents of the flask he has provided at the foot of the great tree to the north, and defeat the fell creatures that appear.
TEXT_CLSLNC005_00438_SEQ_03: You have vanquished the blood bats. Bear word of your success back to Matheomi.
TEXT_CLSLNC005_00438_SEQ_04: Matheomi praises your courage, and pronounces you a lancer of great promise. Your first lesson complete, it is now time to seek out Buscarron, the proprietor of Buscarron's Druthers in the South Shroud.
TEXT_CLSLNC005_00438_SEQ_05: Buscarron gives you a bottle of Fullflower mead, and bids you make an offering of it at Mistalle's Lance, a monument nestled in a rocky cleft to the south of his tavern.
TEXT_CLSLNC005_00438_SEQ_06: You have made an offering of the bottle of Fullflower mead at Mistalle's Lance. Report back to Buscarron at his tavern.
TEXT_CLSLNC005_00438_SEQ_07: You listen intently as Buscarron tells you of the life of Mistalle, a man to whom all students of the lancer's art owe a debt of gratitude. Imbued with newfound appreciation for the guild, the time is come to seek out your third and final instructor. Make your way to Fallgourd Float in the North Shroud, and partake of the wisdom of Vauxclairt.
TEXT_CLSLNC005_00438_SEQ_08: Vauxclairt has set you a trial, the first part of which requires you to procure six fingers from creatures known as balloons.
TEXT_CLSLNC005_00438_SEQ_09: You have procured the requisite number of fingers from slain balloons. Use the grisly digits to kindle a raging flame at the gutted campfire described by Vauxclairt, and lure out the true object of your trial─the red balloon.
TEXT_CLSLNC005_00438_SEQ_10: You have vanquished the red balloon. Bear word of your success back to Vauxclairt.
TEXT_CLSLNC005_00438_SEQ_11: You have completed your training under the three master lancers. Report back to Ywain at the Lancers' Guild.
TEXT_CLSLNC005_00438_SEQ_12:
Ywain welcomes you back to the guild with pride in his eyes, and declares that he has little more to teach you. Only one trial remains before you may call yourself a fully fledged lancer. Dedicate yourself to your lancework, and return when you are ready to undertake the final challenge.

※The next lancer quest will be available from Ywain upon reaching level 30.
TEXT_CLSLNC006_00439_SEQ_00: Guildmaster Ywain would set you a final trial.
TEXT_CLSLNC006_00439_SEQ_01: Your visit to the Lancers' Guild has taken an unexpected turn─it would seem that Foulques has attacked a party of novice lancers in the Central Shroud, meaning the trial must wait. Ywain bids you hasten to your comrades' aid, granting you full discretion to use all necessary force if it will serve to prevent further bloodshed.
TEXT_CLSLNC006_00439_SEQ_02: According to the lancer you rescued, Foulques was headed in the direction of the North Shroud. Intercept him before he has the chance to do any more harm.
TEXT_CLSLNC006_00439_SEQ_03: You have prevailed over the deranged Foulques. Take word of his demise to Ywain, who awaits at the Lancers' Guild.
TEXT_CLSLNC006_00439_SEQ_04: For the courage you displayed in defeating Foulques, Ywain declares you ready to master a devastating new technique: Lance Charge. Having learned all you can from your guildmaster, you set your sights upon challenges yet unknown. Keeping your lessons close to heart, go forth and blaze a new trail with lance in hand.
TEXT_CLSCNJ005_00440_SEQ_00: Brother E-Sumi-Yan requires your assistance in a matter concerning the young conjurer, Sylphie.
TEXT_CLSCNJ005_00440_SEQ_01: After disappearing from the guild without a word, Sylphie was later spotted by a party of conjurers in the South Shroud. Brother E-Sumi has requested that you travel to the area and escort the wayward child back to Gridania. Speak first with Wulfiue in Buscarron's Druthers to learn more of the young conjurer's present state of mind.
TEXT_CLSCNJ005_00440_SEQ_02: Wulfiue has explained that Sylphie, with her sensitivity to the voices of the elementals, must be troubled by the powerful disturbance discovered to the southeast of Buscarron's Druthers. Speak with Sylphie and see how she fares.
TEXT_CLSCNJ005_00440_SEQ_03: Upon reading her mother's journal, Sylphie has become convinced that conjury is to blame for inciting the wrath of nature. Fearing that the party of Hearers sent to cleanse the corruption are further angering the Twelveswood, the young conjurer sets off to stop them. Catch up to Sylphie before she stumbles into danger.
TEXT_CLSCNJ005_00440_SEQ_04: With a helping hand from nature, you have managed to cleanse the massive manifestation of corrupted earth. Speak with Sylphie and learn what the young conjurer is thinking.
TEXT_CLSCNJ005_00440_SEQ_05: After witnessing the battle, Sylphie has conceded that perhaps nature is not as frightening as she believed. Return to Stillglade Fane and report to Brother E-Sumi.
TEXT_CLSCNJ005_00440_SEQ_06:
Having learned of her mother's honest, though misguided, motivations, Sylphie is now determined to embrace the power of nature. At long last, the young conjurer seems to have put her personal troubles behind her. The general mood of hope is dampened, however, by the revelation that the Twelveswood is suffering from some widespread and as-yet-unknown affliction. Return to your studies and seek greater mastery over your art in preparation for the day when Brother E-Sumi calls upon you once more.

※The next conjurer quest will be available from E-Sumi-Yan upon reaching level 30.
TEXT_CLSCNJ006_00441_SEQ_00: Brother E-Sumi-Yan would have you investigate the creeping corruption which threatens the Twelveswood.
TEXT_CLSCNJ006_00441_SEQ_01: Brother E-Sumi-Yan has tasked you and Sylphie with discerning the nature of the corruption spreading through the Twelveswood. Head to Quarrymill in the South Shroud and search the surrounding area for elemental disturbances.
TEXT_CLSCNJ006_00441_SEQ_02: You have located and cleansed a patch of corrupted soil. Speak with Sylphie and determine your next move.
TEXT_CLSCNJ006_00441_SEQ_03: Sylphie senses the taint of further corruption. Follow her directions, and seek out another disturbance.
TEXT_CLSCNJ006_00441_SEQ_04: You have cleansed a second patch of corrupted soil. Speak with Sylphie once more.
TEXT_CLSCNJ006_00441_SEQ_05: Despite your best efforts, Sylphie is certain that the forest still harbors unseen corruption. Trust in her senses, and search for a further elemental disturbance.
TEXT_CLSCNJ006_00441_SEQ_06: You have cleansed a third patch of corrupted soil. Consult Sylphie as to whether your work in the forest is done.
TEXT_CLSCNJ006_00441_SEQ_07: Worryingly, Sylphie insists that an even greater source of corruption yet remains... Follow the young conjurer to the southeast.
TEXT_CLSCNJ006_00441_SEQ_08: You have defeated Akoman. Return to Stillglade Fane and report to Brother E-Sumi-Yan.
TEXT_CLSCNJ006_00441_SEQ_09: At last, Sylphie has felt the embrace of nature and is ready to set forth upon the path of conjury alone. Observing that your experiences alongside the young conjurer have served to deepen your own understanding of the art, Brother E-Sumi rewards you with the potent healing spell Cure II. Though your tutelage under the guildmaster has come to an end, your journey as a conjurer continues ever onwards.
TEXT_CLSACN011_00452_SEQ_00: Murie wishes you to reaffirm your desire to join the Arcanists' Guild.
TEXT_CLSACN011_00452_SEQ_01: Though it is standard practice to present yourself to the guildmaster, Murie explains that the leader of the arcanists is not presently available. You are, instead, to speak with the acting guildmaster, Thubyrgeim.
TEXT_CLSACN011_00452_SEQ_02: After presenting yourself to Thubyrgeim and stating your intention to join the Arcanists' Guild, the scholarly Roegadyn hands you a weathered grimoire. Take the arcane tome in hand, and submit yourself to Thubyrgeim's instruction.
TEXT_CLSACN020_00453_SEQ_00: Murie wishes you to reaffirm your desire to join the Arcanists' Guild.
TEXT_CLSACN020_00453_SEQ_01: Though it is standard practice to present yourself to the guildmaster, Murie explains that the leader of the arcanists is not presently available. You are, instead, to speak with the acting guildmaster, Thubyrgeim.
TEXT_CLSACN020_00453_SEQ_02: Thubyrgeim wishes you to display your commitment to the study of arcanima by means of a simple trial. Travel to lower La Noscea, and slay three wharf rats, three aureliae, and three little ladybugs.
TEXT_CLSACN020_00453_SEQ_03: You have slain the designated creatures. Return to the Arcanists' Guild and speak with the waiting Thubyrgeim.
TEXT_CLSACN020_00453_SEQ_04:
With the completion of your preliminary trial, Acting Guildmaster Thubyrgeim officially welcomes you to the ranks of the Arcanists' Guild. Follow the Roegadyn's advice and continue to hone your arcanima skills and tactics by pitting yourself against the creatures of the wild.

※The next arcanist quest will be available from Thubyrgeim upon reaching level 5.
TEXT_CLSACN021_00454_SEQ_00: Acting Guildmaster Thubyrgeim wishes to judge your aptitude for arcanima.
TEXT_CLSACN021_00454_SEQ_01: Thubyrgeim wishes you to display your commitment to the study of arcanima by means of a simple trial. Travel to lower La Noscea, and slay three wharf rats, three aureliae, and three little ladybugs.
TEXT_CLSACN021_00454_SEQ_02: You have slain the designated creatures. Return to the Arcanists' Guild and speak with the waiting Thubyrgeim.
TEXT_CLSACN021_00454_SEQ_03:
With the completion of your preliminary trial, Acting Guildmaster Thubyrgeim officially welcomes you to the ranks of the Arcanists' Guild. Follow the Roegadyn's advice and continue to hone your arcanima skills and tactics by pitting yourself against the creatures of the wild.

※The next arcanist quest will be available from Thubyrgeim upon reaching level 5.
TEXT_CLSACN050_00455_SEQ_00: Acting Guildmaster Thubyrgeim wishes to assess the improvement of your arcanima skills.
TEXT_CLSACN050_00455_SEQ_01: In order to test your growing aptitude as an arcanist, Thubyrgeim sends you back to the wilds of lower La Noscea to battle more challenging opponents. Slay three wild dodos and three tiny mandragoras.
TEXT_CLSACN050_00455_SEQ_02: You have slain the designated creatures. Return to the Arcanists' Guild and report to Thubyrgeim.
TEXT_CLSACN050_00455_SEQ_03: Now that you have displayed your competence with Carbuncle, you are next to attempt an exercise that simulates the cargo inspections performed by Mealvaan's Gate assessors. Head south of the Zephyr Gate and examine the crates found near the cliffs.
TEXT_CLSACN050_00455_SEQ_04: You have defeated the creatures that lurked within the crates you were ordered to inspect. Now that the cargo is safe to handle, collect the contents and prepare to return to the guild.
TEXT_CLSACN050_00455_SEQ_05: Upon gathering the inspected cargo, you turn to find that your actions had been observed by a strange Miqo'te─Foreseer K'lyhia, a chief assessor for Mealvaan's Gate. As the elected supervisor for your training, the assessor happily appraises your performance, and offers instruction to further improve your arcanist abilities. With the exercise at an end, she bids you return to Thubyrgeim at the Arcanists' Guild.
TEXT_CLSACN050_00455_SEQ_06:
You return to the guild and give your report of the day's lesson. Thubyrgeim explains that the strategically gifted K'lyhia was able to rise to her current position as foreseer using nothing more than an initiate's grimoire. Urging you to heed well the Miqo'te's advice, the acting guildmaster instructs you to continue your tactical training with Carbuncle.

※The next arcanist quest will be available from Thubyrgeim upon reaching level 10.
TEXT_CLSACN100_00456_SEQ_00: Acting Guildmaster Thubyrgeim wishes to assess the improvement of your arcanima skills.
TEXT_CLSACN100_00456_SEQ_01: In order to once again gauge your growth as an arcanist, Thubyrgeim bids you travel to western La Noscea to engage in battle with more ferocious foes. Slay three roselings and three wild jackals.
TEXT_CLSACN100_00456_SEQ_02: You have slain the designated creatures. Return to the Arcanists' Guild and report to Thubyrgeim.
TEXT_CLSACN100_00456_SEQ_03: Satisfied with the results of your training, Thubyrgeim next orders you to accompany K'lyhia on an official inspection. Seek out the foreseer in the practice area and learn the details of your forthcoming duty.
TEXT_CLSACN100_00456_SEQ_04: The foreseer explains that a goblin family of peddlers known as the Boilstox is suspected of dealing in black market goods. Predicting a violent response to her inspection, K'lyhia bids you stand ready to execute a tactic she has dubbed “Stratagem Focus Fire.” Travel to middle La Noscea, and rendezvous with the assessor at the goblins' location.
TEXT_CLSACN100_00456_SEQ_05: You have successfully subdued the Boilstox. Speak with K'lyhia and follow her instructions.
TEXT_CLSACN100_00456_SEQ_06: K'lyhia educates you on the necessity of knowing your own strengths and weaknesses when formulating strategies. Return to Thubyrgeim at the Arcanists' Guild and inform her that the inspection is complete.
TEXT_CLSACN100_00456_SEQ_07:
After returning to the guild and making your report, Thubyrgeim hints that your burgeoning abilities may soon qualify you for a more ambitious assignment. Continue to improve and experiment with your strategies in preparation for the next call to duty.

※The next arcanist quest will be available from Thubyrgeim upon reaching level 15.

TEXT_CLSACN101_00457_SEQ_01: In order to once again gauge your growth as an arcanist, Thubyrgeim bids you travel to western La Noscea to engage in battle with more ferocious foes. Slay three roselings and three wild jackals.
TEXT_CLSACN101_00457_SEQ_02: You have slain the designated creatures. Return to the Arcanists' Guild and report to Thubyrgeim.
TEXT_CLSACN101_00457_SEQ_03: Satisfied with the results of your training, Thubyrgeim next orders you to accompany K'lyhia on an official inspection. Seek out the foreseer in the practice area and learn the details of your forthcoming duty.
TEXT_CLSACN101_00457_SEQ_04: The foreseer explains that a goblin family of peddlers known as the Boilstox is suspected of dealing in black market goods. Predicting a violent response to her inspection, K'lyhia bids you stand ready to execute a tactic she has dubbed “Stratagem Focus Fire.” Travel to middle La Noscea, and rendezvous with the assessor at the goblins' location.
TEXT_CLSACN101_00457_SEQ_05: You have successfully subdued the Boilstox. Speak with K'lyhia and follow her instructions.
TEXT_CLSACN101_00457_SEQ_06: K'lyhia educates you on the necessity of knowing your own strengths and weaknesses when formulating strategies. Return to Thubyrgeim at the Arcanists' Guild and inform her that the inspection is complete.
TEXT_CLSACN101_00457_SEQ_07:
After returning to the guild and making your report, Thubyrgeim hints that your burgeoning abilities may soon qualify you for a more ambitious assignment. Continue to improve and experiment with your strategies in preparation for the next call to duty.

※The next arcanist quest will be available from Thubyrgeim upon reaching level 15.
TEXT_CLSACN150_00458_SEQ_00: Acting Guildmaster Thubyrgeim is awaiting the arrival of the inspection party members.
TEXT_CLSACN150_00458_SEQ_01: Now that all the members of the Mealvaan's Gate inspection party are assembled and briefed, Foreseer K'lyhia is ready to depart. Meet the assessor and the mercenaries outside of Aleport, and prepare to board the merchant vessel Morningstar.
TEXT_CLSACN150_00458_SEQ_02: In order to make your way to the Morningstar, you must first board the small transport craft tied up at the end of the pier. Speak with the landing boat steersman, and announce the arrival of the inspection party.
TEXT_CLSACN150_00458_SEQ_03: You have defeated the thugs sent to impede the inspection. Speak with the steersman once more.
TEXT_CLSACN150_00458_SEQ_04: You have secured the pier for your companions. Head to the landing boat, and await the arrival of Foreseer K'lyhia and the two mercenaries.
TEXT_CLSACN150_00458_SEQ_05: After a mighty battle with the crew of the Morningstar, you manage to arrive before the hatch that leads belowdecks. But just as K'lyhia seeks to begin her inspection, she is suddenly confronted by the ship's dreadful captain. With her grimoire tossed overboard, and her wits scattered by the terrible man standing before her, the foreseer slips into unconsciousness. You have no choice but to abandon the task. Return to the Arcanists' Guild and inform Thubyrgeim of your failure.
TEXT_CLSACN150_00458_SEQ_06:
You learn from Thubyrgeim that the captain of the Morningstar is an exiled pirate by the name of Doesmaga, and that this is not the first time the foreseer has suffered at his hands. Though K'lyhia has sustained no lasting physical injuries, her mind may require some time to recover from the shock of the encounter. The acting guildmaster bids you channel your emotions into your training, and clear your head for forthcoming duties.

※The next arcanist quest will be available from Thubyrgeim upon reaching level 20.
TEXT_CLSACN200_00459_SEQ_00: Acting Guildmaster Thubyrgeim appears unusually distressed.
TEXT_CLSACN200_00459_SEQ_01: Thubyrgeim tells you that the recovering K'lyhia has vanished without a word. Follow the acting guildmaster's suggestion and make inquiries on Hawkers' Alley as to the foreseer's whereabouts.
TEXT_CLSACN200_00459_SEQ_02: After speaking with Dodozan on Hawkers' Alley, you learn that K'lyhia was seeking information concerning a Qiqirn smuggling ring. During their conversation, however, it appears that the Yellowjackets appeared and took the foreseer away. Speak to Ginnade at the Coral Tower to learn more of K'lyhia's fate.
TEXT_CLSACN200_00459_SEQ_03: Ginnade explains that K'lyhia was once a prisoner of Doesmaga, and that the Yellowjackets brought the Miqo'te in for questioning to learn what she knew of the black-hearted pirate. Return to the Arcanists' Guild and report your findings to Thubyrgeim.
TEXT_CLSACN200_00459_SEQ_04: Upon making your report to Thubyrgeim, the acting guildmaster has an epiphany regarding the missing assessor's probable destination. Head to Aleport in western La Noscea and search for K'lyhia.
TEXT_CLSACN200_00459_SEQ_05: You discover the foreseer in Aleport to find that she is already formulating a strategy to recover her lost grimoire. Speak with Thubyrgeim at Oschon's Embrace and lend your strength to K'lyhia's planned attack.
TEXT_CLSACN200_00459_SEQ_06: In order to retrieve the foreseer's grimoire, you have been asked to cooperate in a covert strike on a black market merchant and his retinue. The plan hinges on the successful execution of a classic pincer maneuver at Oschon's Embrace. Take up your position, and await the arrival of the target.
TEXT_CLSACN200_00459_SEQ_07: Though you have managed to retrieve the grimoire, prolonged immersion in seawater has ruined the tome beyond any chance of restoration. K'lyhia, visibly sagging at the sight of her damaged possession, makes her despondent way back to Limsa Lominsa. Return to the Arcanists' Guild and speak with Thubyrgeim.
TEXT_CLSACN200_00459_SEQ_08:
K'lyhia is devastated by the destruction of her grimoire. Promising a means to aid the dispirited assessor, Thubyrgeim asks that you return to your training until she is ready to call upon your help.

※The next arcanist quest will be available from Thubyrgeim upon reaching level 25.
TEXT_CLSACN250_00460_SEQ_00: Acting Guildmaster Thubyrgeim would have your assistance in tracking down a certain someone.
TEXT_CLSACN250_00460_SEQ_01: You learn from Thubyrgeim that the elusive guildmaster, K'rhid Tia, has at long last been spotted. She believes that the guildmaster holds the key to breaking K'lyhia free from her depression. Travel to Memeroon's Trading Post in upper La Noscea, and question a local as to K'rhid Tia's current whereabouts.
TEXT_CLSACN250_00460_SEQ_02: One of the trading post locals tells you of the guildmaster's intended destination. Travel next to Thalaos, and speak with the scholar who makes his camp in the area.
TEXT_CLSACN250_00460_SEQ_03: The scholar Tanga Tonga has a message for you from the guildmaster. It appears you are to locate three slips of parchment upon each of which are written parts of a single clue.
TEXT_CLSACN250_00460_SEQ_04: You have collected the three slips of parchment. Deliver the curious missives to Tanga Tonga.
TEXT_CLSACN250_00460_SEQ_05: After deciphering the Allagan script, Tanga Tonga reads to you the guildmaster's instructions. Though the clues are somewhat cryptic, you determine that you are to travel to Fool Falls and /dance before an old wooden box found somewhere in the area...
TEXT_CLSACN250_00460_SEQ_06: You have located the old wooden box and have danced for it like you've never danced before. Prise open the lid and see what wonders await you.
TEXT_CLSACN250_00460_SEQ_07: You have defeated the tree slugs that sprung when you attempted to open the box. Ready yourself for anything, and attempt to open the box once more.
TEXT_CLSACN250_00460_SEQ_08: The box holds no further nasty surprises for you, and you have found yet another slip of parchment within. The parchment has directed you to Memeroon's Trading Post in upper La Noscea, where you should seek out the owner and /dance for him.
TEXT_CLSACN250_00460_SEQ_09: The guildmaster was watching as you performed your dance for Memeroon, apparently needing a diversion from his studies. After applauding your effort, he gifts you with a new grimoire and recommends you deliver it to K'lyhia. Follow the arcanist's instructions, and /dance for K'lyhia in the Anchor Yard of Limsa Lominsa.
TEXT_CLSACN250_00460_SEQ_10: After performing a dance for K'lyhia, she deduces that you have met with Guildmaster K'rhid Tia. Hand over the new grimoire to the foreseer to answer her question as to why.
TEXT_CLSACN250_00460_SEQ_11: You give the new tome to K'lyhia, and the foreseer soon realizes the significance of the gift: it is within her to shape the world into the reality she desires. And that reality is one in which she defeats Doesmaga. Return to the Arcanists' Guild, and inform Thubyrgeim of the assessor's recovery.
TEXT_CLSACN250_00460_SEQ_12:
Thubyrgeim appears relieved to hear the news of K'lyhia's decision to return to duty. The foreseer is, however, yet bound by the chains of her past. Focus your efforts on your training, and prepare yourself for the forthcoming confrontation with Doesmaga.

※The next arcanist quest will be available from Thubyrgeim upon reaching level 30.
TEXT_CLSACN300_00461_SEQ_00: Acting Guildmaster Thubyrgeim has instructions for you from Foreseer K'lyhia.
TEXT_CLSACN300_00461_SEQ_01: Thubyrgeim explains that K'lyhia has already begun her grand strategy that will culminate in Doesmaga's downfall. Your first task in this daring scheme is to deliver a set of instructions to a fisherman known as Rhylzirn, who can be found in Costa del Sol, in eastern La Noscea.
TEXT_CLSACN300_00461_SEQ_02: After delivering the list to Rhylzirn, you are rewarded with a fresh herring. Your next task, according to the gruff fisherman, is to take the fish you received to the cook, Opylona.
TEXT_CLSACN300_00461_SEQ_03: Opylona, happy to receive the freshly caught herring, insists you take one of her homemade eel pies. The cook then relays instructions from “your arcanist colleague”: you are to deliver the pastry to Master Gegeruju, rather than succumb to the demands of your stomach.
TEXT_CLSACN300_00461_SEQ_04: In return for the eel pie, Master Gegeruju rewards you with a heavy purse of gil. Before you can begin counting out your new fortune, however, you receive K'lyhia's next set of instructions from P'ebaloh. It seems you must deliver the bulging sack of coins to Ealdgyth the dancer.
TEXT_CLSACN300_00461_SEQ_05: For what seems a somewhat exorbitant price, you give the hefty purse to Ealdgyth in exchange for her well-worn pareo and a mysterious leather satchel. As instructed, take the pareo to Drogo, the warehouse foreman.
TEXT_CLSACN300_00461_SEQ_06: Drogo, still questioning his good fortune at receiving Ealdgyth's pareo, gives you a bottle of vintage wine. Take the bottle, and pour a cup for the Morningstar crew members who are drinking at the Flying Shark.
TEXT_CLSACN300_00461_SEQ_07: Impressed with the vintage of the wine, Hirskskrat invites you aboard the Morningstar to talk business with Captain Doesmaga. Speak with Hirskskrat at the jetty when you are ready to depart.
TEXT_CLSACN300_00461_SEQ_08: K'lyhia's clever tactics coupled with your flawless execution have led to the resounding defeat of the pirate Doesmaga. With her past firmly behind her, the foreseer is able to clearly see the reality she desired all along. Return to the Arcanists' Guild and inform Thubyrgeim of K'lyhia's decision to seek out the guildmaster.
TEXT_CLSACN300_00461_SEQ_09: Hand over the odd leather satchel to Thubyrgeim.
TEXT_CLSACN300_00461_SEQ_10: After hearing of your exploits and learning of K'lyhia's decision, Thubyrgeim concludes that the pairing of the arcanima-obsessed guildmaster and foreseer will lead to great advances in the art of the arcanist. Citing your involvement as the catalyst for these developments, the acting guildmaster rewards you with a new technique and encourages you to continue improving in your chosen discipline.
TEXT_CLSPGL011_00532_SEQ_00: Gagaruna wishes you to reaffirm your desire to join the Pugilists' Guild.
TEXT_CLSPGL011_00532_SEQ_01: You have been referred to Hamon, the master of the Pugilists' Guild. Seek him out in the training area.
TEXT_CLSPGL011_00532_SEQ_02: Having formally accepted you into the Pugilists' Guild, Hamon gifts you with your very own pair of hora. Arm yourself with them, and speak to the guildmaster once more to receive your first instructions.
TEXT_CLSPGL020_00533_SEQ_00: Gagaruna wishes you to reaffirm your desire to join the Pugilists' Guild.
TEXT_CLSPGL020_00533_SEQ_01: You have been referred to Hamon, the master of the Pugilists' Guild. Seek him out by the training area.
TEXT_CLSPGL020_00533_SEQ_02: Having formally accepted you into the Pugilists' Guild, Guildmaster Hamon instructs you to go forth and slay three shrews, three hornets, and three marmots.
TEXT_CLSPGL020_00533_SEQ_03: You have succeeded in slaying the specified creatures. Report back to Hamon at the Pugilists' Guild.
TEXT_CLSPGL020_00533_SEQ_04:
Hamon is pleased with your showing against Thanalan's vermin population, and bids you apply yourself to your training.

※The next pugilist quest will be available from Hamon upon reaching level 5.
TEXT_CLSWVR011_00534_SEQ_00: Maronne wishes you to reaffirm your desire to join the Weavers' Guild.
TEXT_CLSWVR011_00534_SEQ_01: Maronne bids you present yourself to the man in charge of guild operations, a towering Roegadyn named Redolent Rose.
TEXT_CLSWVR011_00534_SEQ_02: Redolent Rose grants you leave to study weaving. After providing you with a sewing needle, he instructs you to hold it as you would if you were about to attempt a stitch, and present yourself for inspection.
TEXT_CLSWVR021_00535_SEQ_00: Redolent Rose would like to assign you your first task as a weaver.
TEXT_CLSWVR021_00535_SEQ_01: Satisfied with your ability to hold the needle he gave you, Redolent Rose would now like to see if you can use it. He has tasked you with preparing a spindle of hempen yarn, for which you will require moko grass and lightning shards. While the grass can be purchased from the guild supplier, the shards must be obtained elsewhere. Craft a spindle of hempen yarn and deliver it to the guildmaster.
TEXT_CLSWVR021_00535_SEQ_02:
After a brief inspection, Redolent Rose acknowledges your ability to follow instructions. He bids you return for your next lesson once you have achieved basic proficiency.

※The next weaver quest will be available from Redolent Rose upon reaching level 5.
TEXT_CLSWDK007_00536_SEQ_00: Timbermaster Beatin seems to be smirking in your general direction.
TEXT_CLSWDK007_00536_SEQ_01: Gairhard, the Twin Adder captain for whom you crafted a walnut cane, has once again requested your services. Craft an oak longbow of the highest quality and present it to Beatin for inspection.
TEXT_CLSWDK007_00536_SEQ_02: Your work elicits nary a complaint from Beatin. Deliver the longbow to Gairhard at the Adders' Nest.
TEXT_CLSWDK007_00536_SEQ_03: Gairhard thanks you for the bow, explaining that his squad cannot compromise on the quality of their equipment, due to the demanding nature of their reconnaissance missions. Unfortunately, it is because of one such mission that Gairhard will once again be unable to visit the Carpenters' Guild in person. Deliver the news to Beatin.
TEXT_CLSWDK007_00536_SEQ_04:
Though he understands the responsibilities Gairhard has as a Twin Adder captain, he nevertheless exhibits an uncharacteristic worry upon hearing of his friend's latest mission. Brushing aside his concerns, he states that you will speak again when next he receives a commission for you.

※The next carpenter quest will be available from Beatin upon reaching level 40.
TEXT_CLSWDK008_00537_SEQ_00: Timbermaster Beatin is staring at you quite intently.
TEXT_CLSWDK008_00537_SEQ_01: Gairhard has once again named you as his carpenter of choice and requested that you craft an oak composite bow. Beatin speculates that the bow is for Gairhard himself, and will therefore settle for nothing less than absolute perfection. Craft a quality oak composite bow and present it to the timbermaster.
TEXT_CLSWDK008_00537_SEQ_02: Despite his best efforts, Beatin is unable to find flaw with your craftsmanship. Thus satisfied, he bids you deliver the bow to Gairhard at the Adders' Nest.
TEXT_CLSWDK008_00537_SEQ_03: Somewhat surprised by Beatin's presumption, Gairhard explains that the bow you crafted is intended for another archer under his command. The captain still wields the same maple longbow that the timbermaster crafted for him many years ago. Return to the Carpenters' Guild and speak with Beatin.
TEXT_CLSWDK008_00537_SEQ_04:
Beatin displays mixed emotions upon learning that Gairhard still carries his old longbow. He muses on the revelation briefly, before remembering your presence and subsequently dismissing you.

※The next carpenter quest will be available from Beatin upon reaching level 45.
TEXT_CLSWDK009_00538_SEQ_00: Timbermaster Beatin appears to be carrying a heavy burden...
TEXT_CLSWDK009_00538_SEQ_01: Beatin appears to be despondent over an incident involving Gairhard. See what Nicoliaux knows of the timbermaster's troubles.
TEXT_CLSWDK009_00538_SEQ_02: Nicoliaux tells you of an argument between Beatin and Gairhard which seemed to concern an old bow. Unable to calm himself, Beatin expelled his friend from the guild. While Nicoliaux attempts to console the timbermaster, speak with Gairhard at the Adders' Nest to learn more of this incident.
TEXT_CLSWDK009_00538_SEQ_03: Gairhard does not go into detail about the argument, instead explaining that his commission is of grave import. Having no other recourse, he asks you to craft a cobalt halberd, a jade crook, and a yew longbow. To ensure that the weapons are of superior quality, he also requests that you present them to Beatin for inspection before delivering them to him.
TEXT_CLSWDK009_00538_SEQ_04: Having recovered somewhat from his earlier malaise, Beatin evaluates and approves of your products. Return to the Adders' Nest and deliver the items to Gairhard.
TEXT_CLSWDK009_00538_SEQ_05: After thanking you for your hard work, Gairhard acknowledges that he is as much at fault as Beatin for the earlier dispute. Nevertheless, he and his squad must soon depart Gridania on their next mission, and he will not have another chance to visit the timbermaster for quite some time. Give the captain's regards to Beatin.
TEXT_CLSWDK009_00538_SEQ_06:
Beatin is saddened to hear of Gairhard's departure, though he understands it to be an unavoidable consequence of life as a soldier. He also reveals to you the nature of the previous argument. Apparently, the timbermaster had refused to accept the commission until the captain allowed him to replace Gairhard's old longbow. Though he fears Gairhard's weapon will not last another moon, he regrets having lost his temper, and hopes that his friend will return soon.

※The next carpenter quest will be available from Beatin upon reaching level 50.
TEXT_CLSWDK010_00539_SEQ_00: Timbermaster Beatin is in great distress.
TEXT_CLSWDK010_00539_SEQ_01: Beatin has been inconsolable since the discovery of Gairhard's broken bow. Believing his dear friend to be deceased, he asks that you give him time to be alone. Speak with Nicoliaux and see if he has any ideas as to how you can comfort the timbermaster.
TEXT_CLSWDK010_00539_SEQ_02: Nicoliaux tells you of how the timbermaster flew into a terrible rage upon receiving word of Gairhard's presumed death, breaking anything within reach with his bare hands. Although Nicoliaux believes the situation to be hopeless, he suggests that you present a length of high-quality rosewood lumber to Beatin, in an effort to distract the timbermaster with work.
TEXT_CLSWDK010_00539_SEQ_03: Your attempt to distract Beatin unexpectedly triggers the revelation that Gairhard and his squad must still be alive. However, the timbermaster fears that his friend is in dire need of assistance. Unable to grip a saw due to the injuries he incurred while rampaging through the workshop, he asks you to craft a quality crab bow and meld to it a grade three savage aim materia. Once you have prepared the bow, track down Gairhard in the North Shroud and see that he receives the help he needs.
TEXT_CLSWDK010_00539_SEQ_04: You fortuitously stumble upon Gairhard's squad, which is locked in battle with the Ixal. Amazed by the inexplicable appearance of a carpenter in the middle of a battlefield, he is shocked to receive the crab bow. After sparing the briefest of thanks, he turns his attention to the Ixal and promptly slays their leader with a single arrow. Their forces in disarray, the Ixal are forced to retreat. Return to Gridania and inform Beatin of all that has transpired.
TEXT_CLSWDK010_00539_SEQ_05:
Beatin thanks you profusely for saving Gairhard's life, and states that he owes you a debt that can never be repaid. He furthermore declares that you have grown into a master artisan, and that he has nothing else to teach you. Inspired by your example, the timbermaster resolves to refine his own skills, and wishes you luck in your never-ending journey to become a better carpenter.

※The next carpenter quest will be available from Beatin once you have completed the main scenario quest “Before the Dawn.”
TEXT_CLSPGL021_00553_SEQ_00: Hamon wishes to teach you your first lesson.
TEXT_CLSPGL021_00553_SEQ_01: Having approved of the pair of hora hanging by your hips, Guildmaster Hamon instructs you to go forth and slay three shrews, three hornets, and three marmots.
TEXT_CLSPGL021_00553_SEQ_02: You have succeeded in slaying the specified creatures. Report back to Hamon at the Pugilists' Guild.
TEXT_CLSPGL021_00553_SEQ_03:
Hamon is pleased with your showing against Thanalan's vermin population, and bids you apply yourself to your training.

※The next pugilist quest will be available from Hamon upon reaching level 5.
TEXT_CLSPGL050_00554_SEQ_00: Guildmaster Hamon wishes you to learn the basics of combinations.
TEXT_CLSPGL050_00554_SEQ_01: To get you warmed up for the lesson, Hamon bids you run and pick up the gil that he has scattered across the city. By sprinting as often as possible, you will be able complete the task more swiftly.
TEXT_CLSPGL050_00554_SEQ_02: You have gathered all the gil. Report back to Hamon at the Pugilists' Guild.
TEXT_CLSPGL050_00554_SEQ_03: Hamon is excessively pleased for someone who is getting his own money back. Satisfied that you are warmed up, he next bids you make your way to Scorpion Crossing in western Thanalan. Once there, seek out the four trial stones situated nearby, and deal each of them a Bootshine combo. The impact will draw out earth sprites, which you are required to defeat.
TEXT_CLSPGL050_00554_SEQ_04: You have succeeded in slaying all the earth sprites. Report your success to Hamon at the Pugilists' Guild.
TEXT_CLSPGL050_00554_SEQ_05:
Having praised your performance in the trial, Hamon introduces you to Chuchuto, his assistant and first student. The two of them believe that you have great promise. Train hard, that you might live up to their expectations.

※The next pugilist quest will be available from Hamon upon reaching level 10.
TEXT_CLSPGL100_00555_SEQ_00: Guildmaster Hamon wishes you to build upon your knowledge of combinations.
TEXT_CLSPGL100_00555_SEQ_01: Hamon has set up five dummies outside the guild, along the Merchant Strip. By way of a warm-up for your lesson, he bids you deal each a Bootshine combo.
TEXT_CLSPGL100_00555_SEQ_02: You have struck all five wooden dummies in the prescribed fashion, much to the delight of the cheering onlookers. Report back to Hamon at the Pugilists' Guild.
TEXT_CLSPGL100_00555_SEQ_03: Hamon teaches you an elementary pugilist combo: Bootshine, True Strike, then Snap Punch. To have you practice this rudimentary-yet-essential combination, the guildmaster bids you unleash Snap Punch three times upon the Qiqirn of the Rat's Nest in central Thanalan.
