TEXT_CLSPGL100_00555_SEQ_04: You have succeeded in performing Snap Punch three times on the Qiqirn. Report your success to Hamon at the Pugilists' Guild.
TEXT_CLSPGL100_00555_SEQ_05:
Upon your return to the guild, Hamon expresses his delight at your swift progress. At the same time, however, he is concerned for Chuchuto, who he says has been in a rut ever since her best friend and rival, Rurukuta, disappeared. For now, continue to train hard and improve, that Chuchuto might regain her motivation.

※The next pugilist quest will be available from Hamon upon reaching level 15.
TEXT_CLSPGL150_00558_SEQ_00: Guildmaster Hamon believes you are ready for your next lesson.
TEXT_CLSPGL150_00558_SEQ_01: In order to train you to deal with immense foes, Hamon bids you challenge the toxic toads that nest at the Unholy Heir. As proof of this feat, you are required to obtain five toad legs.
TEXT_CLSPGL150_00558_SEQ_02: You have obtained five toad legs. Present them to Hamon, who awaits you at Black Brush Station.
TEXT_CLSPGL150_00558_SEQ_03: You learn that an illicit drug called somnus is being smuggled into Ul'dah via Black Brush Station. Instead of the lesson he had planned, Hamon bids you track down and apprehend the smugglers. Begin by gathering information from the people of the station.
TEXT_CLSPGL150_00558_SEQ_04: You have acquired sufficient information on the smugglers. Report your findings to Hamon.
TEXT_CLSPGL150_00558_SEQ_05: In all likelihood, the smugglers are operating out of an abandoned Qiqirn lair west of the Coffer & Coffin. Make your way to the lair, and there lie in wait for the criminals.
TEXT_CLSPGL150_00558_SEQ_06: To everyone's surprise, it turns out that one of the smugglers is in fact Rurukuta, the missing pugilist. Upon discovering that his master had grown feeble, Rurukuta became disillusioned and decided to leave the guild. Speak with your guildmaster and learn his side of the story.
TEXT_CLSPGL150_00558_SEQ_07: Beaten and despondent, Hamon admits that the ravages of age have robbed him of his former ability. There seems to be nothing you can do for your guildmaster at the moment. For now, make your way back to the guild, and discuss matters further with Chuchuto.
TEXT_CLSPGL150_00558_SEQ_08:
Despite having learned the truth of Hamon's condition, Chuchuto does not respect him any less. Determined to help her master and benefactor regain his former strength, she asks for your aid. Keep applying yourself to your training, that your improvement might rekindle the fires of passion within the guildmaster.

※The next pugilist quest will be available from Hamon upon reaching level 20.
TEXT_CLSPGL200_00562_SEQ_00: Hamon is in dire need of cheering up.
TEXT_CLSPGL200_00562_SEQ_01: Recent events have left Hamon deeply depressed. Unable to muster up the will to train you, he bids you seek out Chuchuto for your next lesson.
TEXT_CLSPGL200_00562_SEQ_02: Chuchuto believes that if you go about your training the way that Hamon once did, you might serve to stoke the fires of his fighting spirit. To this end, she bids you go to the southern part of Drybone, and there perform a Bootshine combo on the trees that bear indentations. Doing so will stir hornet clouds from their hives. Defeat them and claim three of their stingers.
TEXT_CLSPGL200_00562_SEQ_03: You have obtained the required number of hornet stingers. Present them to Hamon at the Pugilists' Guild.
TEXT_CLSPGL200_00562_SEQ_04: As Chuchuto had expected, the hornet stingers remind Hamon of his younger days, and the man expresses his fervent desire to relive them again. Rather unexpectedly, however, he demands that you now fight him. Let your guildmaster know when you are ready to begin.
TEXT_CLSPGL200_00562_SEQ_05: No sooner does your bout with the guildmaster end than his old rival, Weggfarr Wideaxe, arrives on the scene with Rurukuta in tow. Having made a mockery of Hamon's efforts, Weggfarr challenges him to a public rematch, with the Pugilists' Guild itself as the prize for the winner. Speak with your guildmaster and learn his mind on the matter.
TEXT_CLSPGL200_00562_SEQ_06:
Much to Chuchuto's dismay, Hamon is determined to face Weggfarr again. Back in his prime, the guildmaster defeated the hulking marauder, and he believes he can repeat the feat─with your help. Keep up your training, that your progress might inspire Hamon to regain his former strength.

※The next pugilist quest will be available from Hamon upon reaching level 25.
TEXT_CLSPGL250_00566_SEQ_00: Hamon appears to be in higher spirits.
TEXT_CLSPGL250_00566_SEQ_01: In his eagerness to regain his former strength, Hamon has overtrained and injured himself. Once again, he bids you seek out Chuchuto for your next lesson.
TEXT_CLSPGL250_00566_SEQ_02: Chuchuto has a challenge in mind that you should find stimulating. Make ready for your lesson, and rendezvous with her at Little Ala Mhigo in southern Thanalan.
TEXT_CLSPGL250_00566_SEQ_03: It turns out your training is to help prepare for Master Hamon's training. Take the striking dummies Chuchuto has entrusted to you, and deploy them at the specified locations.
TEXT_CLSPGL250_00566_SEQ_04: You have deployed all the striking dummies. Report back to Chuchuto.
TEXT_CLSPGL250_00566_SEQ_05: Upon returning to Little Ala Mhigo, you are suddenly assailed by Rurukuta and his minions. With Chuchuto's aid, you succeed in subduing him, and finally learn his true agenda. Rurukuta only wants his master to live, even if it means swallowing his pride and running from the impending fight. Satisfied that Hamon is in good hands, Rurukuta takes his leave. Return to the Pugilists' Guild and report all that transpired to your guildmaster.
TEXT_CLSPGL250_00566_SEQ_06:
While appreciative of Rurukuta's sentiments, Hamon is more determined than ever to confront Weggfarr. He bids you keep up your training, lest you be left behind in his dusty wake.

※The next pugilist quest will be available from Hamon upon reaching level 30.
TEXT_CLSPGL300_00567_SEQ_00: Hamon would request your aid in his training.
TEXT_CLSPGL300_00567_SEQ_01: In order to complete his comeback, Hamon requests that you spar with him once more. Meet your guildmaster at Forgotten Springs in southern Thanalan to receive further instructions.
TEXT_CLSPGL300_00567_SEQ_02: By way of a warm-up for your bout, Hamon bids you defeat five of the sandworms that inhabit the area south of Forgotten Springs.
TEXT_CLSPGL300_00567_SEQ_03: You have defeated five sandworms. Report back to Hamon.
TEXT_CLSPGL300_00567_SEQ_04: No sooner does your training end than Chuchuto arrives bearing news that Weggfarr has returned to Ul'dah, and is demanding that Hamon come for the rematch. Make your way to Emerald Avenue, where the odious marauder awaits.
TEXT_CLSPGL300_00567_SEQ_05: To his great shock, Weggfarr finds himself downed by Hamon before he can even swing his axe. Unwilling to admit defeat, he resorts to using a substance he calls pluto to enhance his strength, and comes at you in a frenzy. With Rurukuta fighting beside you this time, you succeed in overcoming the marauder and his minions. Make your way to the Pugilists' Guild, where Hamon awaits.
TEXT_CLSPGL300_00567_SEQ_06: In no small part due to your help, Hamon has defeated his long-standing rival, and the future of the guild is secure. Having realized the error of his ways, Rurukuta declares his intent to embark on a journey of self-discovery. Hamon bids you continue dedicating yourself to your training, that you might one day become a legend in your own right.
TEXT_CLSALC011_00575_SEQ_00: Deitrich wishes to reaffirm your desire to join the Alchemists' Guild.
TEXT_CLSALC011_00575_SEQ_01: For the final stage of your enrollment, you are to seek approval from the guildmaster. Approach Severian where he toils over his workbench within the Alchemists' Guild.
TEXT_CLSALC011_00575_SEQ_02: Severian has approved your initiation into the Alchemists' Guild. Equip the weathered alembic and speak with the guildmaster once more.
TEXT_CLSALC021_00577_SEQ_00: Guildmaster Severian wants you to use the weathered alembic to perform your first alchemic miracle.
TEXT_CLSALC021_00577_SEQ_01: Guildmaster Severian has instructed you to use your alembic to create a bottle of distilled water. The pail of muddy water required for this task can be purchased from the supplier by the guild's entrance. Once you have successfully synthesized a bottle of distilled water, you are to deliver it to the imposing alchemist at his workbench.
TEXT_CLSALC021_00577_SEQ_02:
You have delivered the distilled water to Guildmaster Severian, thus completing your first task as a novice alchemist. He excitedly bids you continue your training, and revel in the joy of each small alchemical miracle.

※The next alchemist quest will be available from Severian upon reaching level 5.
TEXT_CLSALC050_00578_SEQ_00: It appears that Guildmaster Severian has all but forgotten your existence.
TEXT_CLSALC050_00578_SEQ_01: Guildmaster Severian has assigned you a task to assist in your understanding of another fundamental alchemical principle. Synthesize three bottles of antidote and deliver them to your eccentric instructor.
TEXT_CLSALC050_00578_SEQ_02:
You have delivered your synthesized antidote, much to the satisfaction of the obsessive guildmaster. Delve further into the world of alchemy, and learn such joy of discovery that you scarce remember to eat or sleep.

※The next alchemist quest will be available from Severian upon reaching level 10.
TEXT_CLSALC101_00580_SEQ_00: It seems some unexpected matter has Guildmaster Severian more agitated than usual.
TEXT_CLSALC101_00580_SEQ_01: Severian has placed you square in the path of an incoming guild task meant for his workbench. Synthesize twelve lumps of beeswax and deliver them to the guildmaster.
TEXT_CLSALC101_00580_SEQ_02:
Able to focus on his personal research undisturbed, Guildmaster Severian seems overjoyed at your competent handling of his “bothersome” task. Continue to improve your skills through the completion of tradecraft leves, and prepare for whatever role the unpredictable alchemist has in store for you.

※The next alchemist quest will be available from Severian upon reaching level 15.
TEXT_CLSALC150_00581_SEQ_00: Guildmaster Severian appears to be losing the battle against exhaustion.
TEXT_CLSALC150_00581_SEQ_01: The sleepy-eyed guildmaster has assigned you another task. Create a potion of intelligence and a potion of dexterity and bring them to Severian.
TEXT_CLSALC150_00581_SEQ_02: You have brought the two potions to the guildmaster, as requested. Severian praises your alchemical brilliance, explaining that the concoctions you have created would be beyond the skills of most novice alchemists. At his further behest, you are to take the potions to the Coliseum and deliver them directly to Ardara, the expectant customer.
TEXT_CLSALC150_00581_SEQ_03: You have delivered the potions to Ardara. The gladiator fan seems relieved that it was you, and not the guildmaster, who was in charge of concocting her gifts for Franz the Fair. Return to Severian, and inform him that your task is complete.
TEXT_CLSALC150_00581_SEQ_04:
You rouse the guildmaster from his slumber with your report. What all-consuming alchemical goal drives Severian to work himself to the point of exhaustion? Now mindful to not allow yourself to become too absorbed in your studies, you return to your mastering of alchemy.

※The next alchemist quest will be available from Severian upon reaching level 20.
TEXT_CLSALC200_00582_SEQ_00: Guildmaster Severian wishes to test your growing proficiency with a new task.
TEXT_CLSALC200_00582_SEQ_01: You have been entrusted with the request of an arcanist, a man of whose name you are likely to remain ignorant should you be forced to rely on Guildmaster Severian's selective memory. Construct the materia-enhanced engraved hard leather grimoire and deliver it to your forgetful tutor. Yew logs, one of the materials required in the creation of the tome, must either be obtained through gathering, or purchased from the market boards of the Sapphire Avenue Exchange. And should you wish for a more patient explanation on materia, Severian suggests that you would be better served traveling to the Bonfire in central Thanalan and visiting the camp of the goblin Mutamix.
TEXT_CLSALC200_00582_SEQ_02:
You have delivered an engraved hard leather grimoire to Severian. Despite being left little choice but to visit the guild in person to collect his order, the arcanist seems overjoyed with the grimoire's quality. Bask in the warm glow of the client's praise as you nevertheless remain focused on upholding your new reputation as a “master alchemist.”

※The next alchemist quest will be available from Severian upon reaching level 25.
TEXT_CLSALC250_00583_SEQ_00: Guildmaster Severian's foul mood hints at another unwanted task awaiting your assistance.
TEXT_CLSALC250_00583_SEQ_01: The guildmaster concludes that the duty forced upon him by his colleagues is more suitable for his assistant's continued education. Synthesize a high-quality pinch of natron and deliver it to your manic instructor.
TEXT_CLSALC250_00583_SEQ_02:
After inspecting your pinch of powdery magnificence, the duly impressed guildmaster launches into an explanation of the practical applications of natron, and alchemy in general. Should you perform one last task for Severian, he promises to permit you to assist him as he seeks to uncover the ultimate secret of alchemy. Until that time comes, you must endeavor to attain ever-loftier heights of skill in your chosen discipline.

※The next alchemist quest will be available from Severian upon reaching level 30.
TEXT_CLSALC300_00584_SEQ_00: Guildmaster Severian wishes to once more gauge the progress of your alchemical mastery.
TEXT_CLSALC300_00584_SEQ_01: Your task from the guildmaster requires you to concoct a harmful agent. Synthesize three high-quality flasks of weak blinding potion and deliver them to your distracted superior.
TEXT_CLSALC300_00584_SEQ_02: Guildmaster Severian praises the potential for chaos present in the baleful brews you have created. Your task now requires you to deliver the blinding potions to the client─a Miqo'te lass affiliated with one of Ul'dah's less savory groups. You will find her awaiting your arrival somewhere in Pearl Lane.
TEXT_CLSALC300_00584_SEQ_03: After accepting the flasks, the Miqo'te reveals herself to be a Sultansworn by the name of W'bulea. She had previously infiltrated the gang known as the Velvet Hands after learning of their scheme to rob the palace. Disappointed with Severian's eagerness to accommodate the gang's plans, she asks you to convey a message back to the guildmaster.
TEXT_CLSALC300_00584_SEQ_04:
You deliver W'bulea's message to Severian, but the guildmaster flatly refuses to consider her demand for the return of her sister, W'nahja. Further contradicting the Sultansworn's wishes, the determined Severian bids you prepare for your role as his assistant as the culmination of his great and mysterious alchemical endeavor draws near.

※The next alchemist quest will be available from Severian upon reaching level 35.
TEXT_JOBWAR501_00585_SEQ_00: Curious Gorge looks eager to expand his combat repertoire.
TEXT_JOBWAR501_00585_SEQ_01: Curious Gorge tells you of his brother, Broken Mountain, who is still recovering from his wounds at Camp Bronze Lake. The siblings remain steadfast in their resolve to spread the teachings of their people across Eorzea, although Broken Mountain seems reluctant to take up the axe once more. Instead, he now pursues more scholarly studies─during which he has stumbled upon information regarding ancient martial techniques. If you would know more of such things, make your way to Camp Bronze Lake and speak with Broken Mountain.
TEXT_JOBWAR501_00585_SEQ_02: Broken Mountain tells you of a legendary hero named Mythril Heart whose combat prowess is detailed at length in accounts he has discovered. Skeptical of their veracity, he sees no point in studying them further. However, Curious Gorge strongly believes otherwise, and even his old comrade-in-arms Wheiskaet seems to think there may be truth in them as well. Yielding to pressure, Broken Mountain states that he will reconsider his stance if you uncover proof that Mythril Heart was real. Recalling that the hero's final journey took him to Silvertear Falls, Curious Gorge suggests that you speak with the Sons of Saint Coinach, who conduct their research in Mor Dhona.
TEXT_JOBWAR501_00585_SEQ_03: Though none of the researchers know of Mythril Heart, it becomes clear that artifacts not of Allagan origin are often left untouched. Scour the shores of Silvertear Falls and see if you can find proof that the Hellsguard hero once walked these lands.
TEXT_JOBWAR501_00585_SEQ_04: As if by fate, you come upon an axe that is quite unremarkable outside of the crudely engraved letters “MH” on its haft. Could it be the weapon once wielded by the legendary Mythril Heart? Present it to Broken Mountain and see if it serves as proof that the stories were not mere faerie tales.
TEXT_JOBWAR501_00585_SEQ_05:
Broken Mountain declares the weapon to be that of the legendary Mythril Heart, proving that the stories he discovered were true. Convinced of the hero's existence, he agrees to resume his studies of the ancient tomes in order to unlock the secrets of Mythril Heart's techniques─though he also acknowledges that the techniques are like to rouse the inner beast like none before.

※The next warrior quest will be available from Broken Mountain upon reaching level 52.
TEXT_JOBWAR520_00586_SEQ_00: Broken Mountain seems to have reservations about digging deeper into this newfound knowledge.
TEXT_JOBWAR520_00586_SEQ_01: Before he will share his latest findings regarding Mythril Heart with you, Broken Mountain asks you to accompany Curious Gorge to the Coerthas central highlands and slay a fearsome beast. Though it appears to be unrelated to his research, Broken Mountain assures you that this request is of the utmost importance. Rendezvous with him at the Weeping Saint and see the deed done.
TEXT_JOBWAR520_00586_SEQ_02: While defending his brother from the beast's sudden attack, Curious Gorge succumbs to his inner beast, and you have no choice but to subdue him. As you land your final blow, your own inner beast rouses from its slumber with such ferocity that you lose consciousness momentarily. Afterwards, Broken Mountain forbids his brother from assisting you further in your quest, for fear of him losing control again. Though clearly distressed, Curious Gorge accepts his brother's judgment. Rest and visit Broken Mountain in Camp Bronze Lake when you are ready to continue your conversation.
TEXT_JOBWAR520_00586_SEQ_03:
Merely recalling your duel with Curious Gorge causes your inner beast to stir─a revelation which leads Broken Mountain to remember a passage he came across in his research: “Only the flames of animosity may temper a warrior's soul.” He interprets this to mean that the inner beast stirs when a warrior faces an opponent who pushes him to surpass his physical and mental limits, and that only in that moment can he attain mastery of new techniques. Believing this to be the means by which the heroes of eld achieved their legendary feats, he implores you to challenge yourself as they did.

※The next warrior quest will be available from Broken Mountain upon reaching level 54.
TEXT_CLSWVR050_00587_SEQ_00: Redolent Rose is now willing to assign you your second task.
TEXT_CLSWVR050_00587_SEQ_01: The guildmaster wants to see whether you are capable of crafting a finished product. To this end, he bids you weave three pairs of hempen breeches. Craft the requested items and present them to him.
TEXT_CLSWVR050_00587_SEQ_02:
Whilst evaluating your work, Redolent Rose speaks on the importance of satisfying the customer's desires and avoiding self-indulgent flourishes. He then presents to you a spinning wheel, which will aid you in your weaving endeavors.

※The next weaver quest will be available from Redolent Rose upon reaching level 10.
TEXT_JOBWAR540_00588_SEQ_00: Broken Mountain has some concerns about his brother.
TEXT_JOBWAR540_00588_SEQ_01: Broken Mountain gives news of Curious Gorge, who has joined the Maelstrom's defensive operations against the kobolds in hopes of training against live enemies. Even though he wants nothing more than to improve, it seems his fear of losing control once again is keeping him from fighting with all his strength. In order to serve as an example to Curious Gorge, and future warriors, Broken Mountain tells you to follow in Mythril Heart's footsteps by hunting the fearsome grizzly bears inhabiting Abalathia's Spine. Go to Tailfeather in the Dravanian forelands and ask the hunters there for any information that might help you track down these colossal creatures.
TEXT_JOBWAR540_00588_SEQ_02: The hunters at Tailfeather share stories of the massive grizzlies, none of them encouraging. One hunter begrudgingly informs you that some have been known to lure the bears out with Whilom salmon, which can be found at the northwestern part of the Whilom River. Go to the riverbanks and gather any fish you can find.
TEXT_JOBWAR540_00588_SEQ_03: The hunter's advice was sound, and you have found enough fish to draw one of the beasts out from hiding. Go to the Hundred Throes and use the Whilom salmon to draw a grizzly out, then slay one of them in its watering hole.
TEXT_JOBWAR540_00588_SEQ_04: You have defeated a fearsome Whilom grizzly, as Mythril Heart before you, and the pitched battle awakens your inner beast from its slumber. Return to Camp Bronze Lake and inform Broken Mountain of your deeds.
TEXT_JOBWAR540_00588_SEQ_05:
Upon returning to Camp Bronze Lake, Curious Gorge enthusiastically informs you of the Maelstrom's successful defense against the kobold attacks, and returns to train for his next mission. However, Wheiskaet has a different story. Although the operation succeeded, it seems Curious Gorge remains frightened of losing control in battle. With the beast tribes growing bolder by the day, there is little hope for the Maelstrom to take warriors seriously if Curious Gorge continues to underperform. Broken Mountain will continue to do research into how to tame the inner beast and encourages you to continue your training in preparation for the next step.

※The next warrior quest will be available from Broken Mountain upon reaching level 56.
TEXT_CLSWVR101_00589_SEQ_00: Redolent Rose appears perturbed and in need of assistance.
TEXT_CLSWVR101_00589_SEQ_01: Forgoing explanations, the guildmaster requests that you make him a dozen bolts of undyed hempen cloth fast. Craft the required items, and deliver them to him posthaste.
TEXT_CLSWVR101_00589_SEQ_02:
Though the guildmaster is grateful for your aid in supplying the Immortal Flames' pressing need, he cannot hide his contempt for the adventurers whose irresponsible behavior occasioned it. Happily, the incident did present you with an opportunity to prove your worth, and Redolent Rose is now of the opinion that you are ready to accept commissions from Eustace at the Quicksand. You have taken a momentous step towards working for the Sunsilk brand.

※The next weaver quest will be available from Redolent Rose upon reaching level 15.
TEXT_CLSWVR150_00590_SEQ_00: Redolent Rose has a special task for you.
TEXT_CLSWVR150_00590_SEQ_01: The guildmaster wishes to reward a regular customer's loyalty with his choice of bespoke garments. Meet with Wawarukka on Onyx Lane and offer your services.
TEXT_CLSWVR150_00590_SEQ_02: Wawarukka is surprised by your generous offer, as he does not consider himself a regular customer, his many purchases having been made on behalf of the Miners' Guild. Loath to look a gift chocobo in the mouth, however, he asks you to craft a cotton scarf and a pair of cotton shepherd's slops for him. Prepare the requested garments and deliver them to Redolent Rose, ready for a final fitting.
TEXT_CLSWVR150_00590_SEQ_03:
Although Redolent Rose offers to provide Wawarukka with even finer garments, the miner is more than satisfied with the scarf and slops you have made. The guildmaster can only defer to the customer's decision.

※The next weaver quest will be available from Redolent Rose upon reaching level 20.
TEXT_CLSWVR200_00591_SEQ_00: Redolent Rose has a momentous task in mind for you.
TEXT_CLSWVR200_00591_SEQ_01: The guildmaster believes you are finally ready to undertake your first Sunsilk commission. Your client awaits you outside Sunsilk Tapestries on the Steps of Nald.
TEXT_CLSWVR200_00591_SEQ_02: Your client, a wealthy Lalafell named Mamajaru, bids you make a materia-enhanced cotton acton that will not hinder his training in the gladiatorial arts. However, he neglects to specify the type of materia he needs. Consult with the guildmaster to determine the best course of action.
TEXT_CLSWVR200_00591_SEQ_03: The guildmaster expresses doubt as to Mamajaru's ability to distinguish between different types of materia, and suggests you use whichever kind comes readily to hand. He adds that if you wish to learn more about materia, you should seek the counsel of a scholar who dwells in a camp near the Bonfire in central Thanalan. Prepare the materia-enhanced cotton acton and deliver it to Redolent Rose.
TEXT_CLSWVR200_00591_SEQ_04:
In what apparently passes for a show of approval, Mamajaru takes your acton and departs with nary a word of thanks. Redolent Rose, however, is happy to praise your work, adding that it is a weaver's task to make the world see the client as the client wishes to be seen─even if that wish has no basis in reality.

※The next weaver quest will be available from Redolent Rose upon reaching level 25.
TEXT_CLSWVR250_00592_SEQ_00: Redolent Rose has need of your assistance yet again.
TEXT_CLSWVR250_00592_SEQ_01: A sudden deluge of orders has the Weavers' Guild working at full stretch, and Redolent Rose cannot spare the time to attend a consultation with one of his clients. Go in the guildmaster's stead to the Gold Court and speak with Babawai and his daughter Kokomo.
TEXT_CLSWVR250_00592_SEQ_02: Your meeting does not prove as enlightening as you had hoped due to the complete disinterest of your young client. Return to the Weavers' Guild and tell Redolent Rose what you have learned.
TEXT_CLSWVR250_00592_SEQ_03: After a moment's consideration, Redolent Rose decides to craft a velveteen dress. Conscious of Babawai's reputation for exacting standards, he concludes that only the finest fabric will suffice. Weave a bolt of high-quality velveteen and deliver it to the guildmaster.
TEXT_CLSWVR250_00592_SEQ_04:
The guildmaster praises your velveteen, and assures you that it will make a most magnificent dress─albeit one which he suspects Kokomo has no intention of wearing.

※The next weaver quest will be available from Redolent Rose upon reaching level 30.
TEXT_CLSWVR300_00593_SEQ_00: Redolent Rose has a job perfectly suited to your talents.
TEXT_CLSWVR300_00593_SEQ_01: Wawarukka, the miner whose loyal custom Redolent Rose seemed so eager to reward, has approached the guild with another commission. Unusually, however, it would seem he seeks something other than mining gear this time. Speak with Wawarukka to learn the details of his request.
TEXT_CLSWVR300_00593_SEQ_02: Wawarukka is smitten with a girl from a wealthy family, and is eager to make a good first impression. To this end, he wishes to purchase the finest pair of velveteen gaiters money can buy. Craft the items to the best of your ability and deliver them to Redolent Rose.
TEXT_CLSWVR300_00593_SEQ_03:
You discover to your horror that Wawarukka's new gaiters are but a small part of a gruesomely mismatched ensemble. Even as Redolent Rose tries to warn the poor fellow that he's making a terrible mistake, the oblivious Lalafell bounds off to profess his love, leaving the guildmaster to comfort himself with the thought that the unwary lady may yet see past his friend's bizarre appearance. Quite why she would is another question...

※The next weaver quest will be available from Redolent Rose upon reaching level 35.
TEXT_JOBWAR560_00596_SEQ_00: Broken Mountain knows someone in need of a legendary adventurer.
TEXT_JOBWAR560_00596_SEQ_01: Wheiskaet informs you that pirates in thrall to the Sahagin have started brazen attacks along the La Noscean coasts, further straining the already-limited resources of the Maelstrom. He has requested that you aid him in the defense of Limsa Lominsa, and promises fierce battles that will test even your battle-worn axe. Report to Aleport and speak with the storm captain for details of your mission.
TEXT_JOBWAR560_00596_SEQ_02: The storm captain begins the mission briefing, informing you that the Serpent Reavers plan to mount an offensive from the sea, using the Isles of Umbra as a foothold. Determining that the best course of action is to scatter the pirates before they have a chance to carry out their attack, he instructs you to make haste to the isles. Speak with the captain once you have landed ashore the Isles of Umbra.
TEXT_JOBWAR560_00596_SEQ_03: The captain's assault against the Serpent Reavers on the Isles of Umbra has begun. Speak to the storm captain to join in the fray.
TEXT_JOBWAR560_00596_SEQ_04: The troops are making steady progress into the pirate foothold. Speak with the storm captain to find out where to proceed to next.
TEXT_JOBWAR560_00596_SEQ_05: Although several allies have fallen to the Reavers' blades, you manage to cut through their next line of defense. The storm captain's face has a look of desperate determination─speak with him to find out where the next step of pirate killing begins.
TEXT_JOBWAR560_00596_SEQ_06: The remnants of the Maelstrom outfit have suffered through several waves of relentless Serpent Reavers, but the pirate encampment is finally in sight. Speak with the storm captain once more before proceeding.
TEXT_JOBWAR560_00596_SEQ_07: The Serpent Reaver captain is in sight, with his ferocious beast in tow. Save the storm captain from the pirate's barrage and steel yourself for the final battle.
TEXT_JOBWAR560_00596_SEQ_08: The Reaver captain and his pet monster are no match for a warrior who follows in the path of Mythril Heart. Rescue the storm captain and scatter the last remnants of the Serpent Reavers.
TEXT_JOBWAR560_00596_SEQ_09: You've rescued the storm captain, who expresses his gratitude for your help in repelling the Serpent Reavers. However, he is hesitant to remain on the Isles of Umbra for a second longer than he has to, and bids the party meet up again at Aleport. Speak with the storm captain again once everyone is safely out of those haunted isles.
TEXT_JOBWAR560_00596_SEQ_10: The morale and strength the troops gained from your presence was key to your victory, and despite the relative weakness of the Serpent Reavers, the souls of the warriors' ancestors bestow upon you a new technique, indicating that the resolve to defend your allies is just as effective as resolving to kill your enemies. After you have recovered from your ordeal, speak with the captain again.
TEXT_CLSMIN011_00597_SEQ_00: Linette wishes you to reaffirm your desire to join the Miners' Guild.
TEXT_CLSMIN011_00597_SEQ_01: You have been referred to Adalberta, the master of the Miners' Guild. Meet her at the bar.
TEXT_CLSMIN011_00597_SEQ_02: Adalberta warmly welcomes you to the guild, and presents you with your very own─very old─pickaxe. Take up the tool of your new trade, and speak with the guildmaster again to be issued your first task.
TEXT_JOBWAR580_00598_SEQ_00: Broken Mountain has something urgent to discuss with you.
TEXT_JOBWAR580_00598_SEQ_01: Broken Mountain, impressed with your progress, gives word that the Maelstrom is once again in need of extra bodies to aid in another operation against the beast tribes. Wheiskaet and Curious Gorge have visited Camp Bronze Lake seeking volunteers, and have asked for you by name. Speak with Curious Gorge to hear what it is Limsa Lominsa requires.
TEXT_JOBWAR580_00598_SEQ_02: Wheiskaet informs you that Maelstrom scouts have reported that kobolds of the 179th Order are tirelessly producing bombs in preparation for an all-out assault on Camp Bronze Lake. Maelstrom troops hope to intercept the bombs at Zelma's Run before they can do any damage, and Wheiskaet asks the aid of the two fiercest warriors he knows. Once again, Curious Gorge is afraid of his inner beast taking hold, especially in such a confined area, but Broken Mountain insists that this will be the ideal situation for Gorge to establish his dominance over the beast within. Curious Gorge asks to be alone and leaves, while Wheiskaet gives you the details of the Maelstrom operation. Speak with the despondent Curious Gorge once more before heading off to Zelma's Run and see if he can be convinced to join in on the fight.
TEXT_JOBWAR580_00598_SEQ_03: You find Curious Gorge looking crestfallen in one of the camp's hot springs. He admits that his brother is right, and that the correct path is plain, but can't seem to shake his fear of being overcome by the inner beast. He comes up with a last, desperate strategy: you must /slap him with all the strength you can muster, hopefully driving the cowardice from him for good.
TEXT_JOBWAR580_00598_SEQ_04: Your slap rouses Curious Gorge out of his slump, and he stands straight as if a warrior reborn. Determined to show the kobolds no quarter, he rushes to meet the storm captain at Zelma's Run. Follow him and rendezvous with the rest of the troops. Speak with the storm captain when you are ready to start the Maelstrom's next operation.
TEXT_JOBWAR580_00598_SEQ_05: You arrive at the entrance to Zelma's Run to see the same storm captain from your operation against the Serpent Reavers along with two other Maelstrom troops and Curious Gorge, who is dressed proudly in his warrior's garb. You have been assigned to intercept the 179th Order kobolds on the east side of the valley. Ready your axe and speak with the Maelstrom troop at your assigned area, but be on the lookout for any signs of kobolds.
TEXT_JOBWAR580_00598_SEQ_06: In his haste, the storm private assigned as your partner falls victim to a kobold ambush. When you run to his aid, the kobolds attempt to swarm you and the storm private, but your axe cuts them down one after the other. With the kobolds of the 179th Order slain or scattered, check on the storm private to see that his wounds are not severe.
TEXT_JOBWAR580_00598_SEQ_07: The storm private's wounds are but light, and there are no remaining kobolds in sight. The defense of the eastern side of Zelma's Run is a success. Check with Curious Gorge to the west for news of their progress.
TEXT_JOBWAR580_00598_SEQ_08: It seems Curious Gorge and the other Maelstrom troops had no trouble in intercepting and dispatching the kobolds on the western side of Zelma's Run. The storm captain gives particular credit to Curious Gorge's ferocity in battle, and promises to give high praise in his report to Maelstrom Command. After the others return home, Curious Gorge tells you he was finally able to fight with abandon without succumbing to his inner beast. Nevertheless, he still doubts his own ability to maintain control in a more pitched battle. Curious Gorge returns to Camp Bronze Lake to rest, and asks you to give word of your victory to Broken Mountain upon your return.
TEXT_JOBWAR580_00598_SEQ_09:
Broken Mountain is pleased that his brother was able to fight to his fullest, but disheartened by the news of his brother's continuing self-doubt. There is little time to consider the matter, however, as Wheiskaet brings news that Storm Marshal Slafyrsyn is seeking the aid of capable warriors to help defend Limsa Lominsa from the Sahagin menace. Broken Mountain suggests that if you were to succeed in this operation, it might lift the reputation of the warriors out of obscurity and into Eorzean history books. Continue your training in preparation for what promises to be the most critical test of your strength yet.

※The next warrior quest will be available from Broken Mountain upon reaching level 60.
TEXT_CLSMIN021_00599_SEQ_00: Adalberta wants to assign you your first task.
TEXT_CLSMIN021_00599_SEQ_01: Having admitted you to the Miners' Guild, Adalberta assigns you a task intended to help you get to grips with your pickaxe. Use the venerable tool to gather ten chunks of copper ore outside either the Gate of the Sultana or the Gate of Nald, and deliver them to the guildmaster.
TEXT_CLSMIN021_00599_SEQ_02:
After expressing her satisfaction with your inaugural haul of copper ore, Adalberta advises you to focus your efforts on refining your technique. She pledges to assign you another task when you have become more proficient.

※The next miner quest will be available from Adalberta upon reaching level 5.
TEXT_CLSMIN050_00600_SEQ_00: Adalberta wants to teach you the importance of knowing the land.
TEXT_CLSMIN050_00600_SEQ_01: In recognition of your progress, Adalberta has set you a new task. Wishing to impress upon you the importance of knowing the land, the guildmaster bids you procure ten bone chips. Mine the required quantity beyond the Gate of Nald and deliver them to her.
TEXT_CLSMIN050_00600_SEQ_02:
After counting your bone chips, Adalberta explains that knowledge acquired through practical experience is what allows a miner to grow. With your trusty gathering log to guide you, venture forth into the wilderness in search of further riches, and amass a wealth of knowledge in so doing.

※The next miner quest will be available from Adalberta upon reaching level 10.
TEXT_JOBWAR600_00601_SEQ_00: Broken Mountain is steeling himself for the decisive battle.
TEXT_JOBWAR600_00601_SEQ_01: Broken Mountain informs you that the Sahagin have begun their assault on the tidegates. Although Curious Gorge remains doubtful about his ability to control his inner beast, the defense will require two warriors for it to be successful. Broken Mountain will not let you and his brother shoulder all of the burden, however, and he informs you that he will aid you with what limited healing magicks he has at his disposal. Speak with Curious Gorge for further details of the defensive operation.
TEXT_JOBWAR600_00601_SEQ_02: The three burly Roegadyn fighters are ready to depart for the decisive battle. Wheiskaet informs you that the Sahagin plan to use massive seabeasts to overrun the tidegate, and that he will be joining you despite the wounds he suffered in his fight with the primal Titan. Curious Gorge, still overcome with self-doubt, asks you to once again dispel the fear from his heart with an inspiring /slap to the face.
TEXT_JOBWAR600_00601_SEQ_03: Your slap serves to rouse Curious Gorge's inner beast even more so than his fight with the kobolds, restoring his confidence and preparing him for his fight against the Sahagin threat. With a newfound courage, he rushes to Camp Skull Valley─follow him and speak with Storm Commander Falkbryda to receive a briefing on your critical mission.
TEXT_JOBWAR600_00601_SEQ_04: Your allies are all waiting at the southern gate for the fury of the Sahagin. Speak with Storm Marshal Eynzahr to start the desperate battle.
TEXT_JOBWAR600_00601_SEQ_05: The Sahagin come in waves, one after the other, only to be cut down like fish to the slaughter. Curious Gorge fights at a fever pitch, eventually falling to the ground in a struggle to control his inner beast. In the last desperate moment, he triumphantly quells the rising fury of his inner beast, at last conquering it for good. Then, in a futile attempt to break through the tidegate's mighty defenders, the Sahagin captain attacks with his massive seabeast, but they fall quickly before the full strength of two unbridled warriors. With the Sahagin threat finally quelled, speak with Curious Gorge to celebrate this tremendous victory together.
TEXT_JOBWAR600_00601_SEQ_06:
Curious Gorge and his brother are ecstatic that the former was able to finally tame his inner beast, but that is not the only good news waiting for them. With the Sahagin threat quelled, Storm Marshal Eynzahr informs them that the Maelstrom will move forward with its plan to train its troops in the way of the warrior, and that Maelstrom Command has requested that the two brothers be the first two to teach the fledgling warriors. Little by little, the dream that they carried down with them from their humble mountain village will come to pass, as more people of Eorzea learn the teachings of their ancestors. Curious Gorge, fueled by his new confidence, swears that he will master the techniques of eld, and promises a fearsome duel once you both reach the peak of your martial prowess. Take care not to neglect your training, lest one day Curious Gorge become the mightiest warrior in Eorzea.

※The next warrior quest will be available from Curious Gorge once you have completed the main scenario quest “The Far Edge of Fate.”
TEXT_CLSMIN101_00602_SEQ_00: Adalberta needs you to undertake a task in the name of the Miners' Guild.
TEXT_CLSMIN101_00602_SEQ_01: The guild has received an order from Amajina & Sons Mineral Concern for ten chunks of obsidian. Procure the requisite number in the vicinity of the Hammers in western Thanalan, and deliver them to Adalberta.
TEXT_CLSMIN101_00602_SEQ_02:
You learn that the fruits of your labors will be utilized in the crafting of macuahuimeh, a type of wooden sword which predates metalworking. Although obsidian is no longer widely used, there are still some who will pay good coin for it. Adalberta encourages you to be aware of the needs of such customers, as the demand for materials with highly specific applications often outstrips supply.

※The next miner quest will be available from Adalberta upon reaching level 15.
TEXT_CLSMIN150_00603_SEQ_00: Adalberta would like you to meet a prominent member of the mining community.
TEXT_CLSMIN150_00603_SEQ_01: It would seem your recent efforts have attracted the attention of Deep Canyon, vice foreman of Amajina & Sons Mineral Concern. According to Adalberta, he is eager to meet with you, and has come to the guild for that very purpose. Seek him near the entrance, and introduce yourself.
TEXT_CLSMIN150_00603_SEQ_02: Wishing to assess your reported potential for himself, Deep Canyon bids you procure ten onzes of cinnabar. For the sake of formality, report back to Adalberta prior to beginning your task.
TEXT_CLSMIN150_00603_SEQ_03: According to Adalberta, ten onzes of cinnabar will not be easy to find. Nevertheless, the guildmaster believes you equal to the task. Search for the elusive mineral in the vicinity of Horizon in western Thanalan, and when you have found the requisite quantity, deliver the lot to Deep Canyon.
TEXT_CLSMIN150_00603_SEQ_04:
Deep Canyon is impressed that you were able to find the quantity of cinnabar he requested, and promises you more work from the Concern. Now convinced of your potential, he advises you to invest in better gear, arguing that the benefits of quality equipment far outweigh the initial cost.

※The next miner quest will be available from Adalberta upon reaching level 20.
TEXT_CLSMIN200_00604_SEQ_00: Adalberta has a mind to teach you about materia.
TEXT_CLSMIN200_00604_SEQ_01: You learn that Deep Canyon used to be Adalberta's friend and mentor, but that something has driven a wedge between them. Though they do not see eye to eye on many things, Adalberta concurs with Deep Canyon's advice on the matter of equipment, and proposes materia as a means to augment your gear. In order to teach you about these curious crystals while giving you field experience, she bids you obtain fifteen fragments of grade 1 carbonized matter, a catalyst formerly used in the materia melding process. Dig for the substance around the De Nevelle Checkpoint in middle La Noscea, and deliver the required amount to Adalberta.
TEXT_CLSMIN200_00604_SEQ_02:
Adalberta explains that materia can only be attached to equipment by Disciples of the Hand, a process that once required the use of catalysts procured by Disciples of the Land. Due to advances in materia melding techniques, however, these substances have since become obsolete. Although this has led to reduced work for miners and botanists alike, Adalberta tries to be happy for progress.

※The next miner quest will be available from Adalberta upon reaching level 25.
TEXT_CLSMIN250_00605_SEQ_00: Adalberta needs you to take on the work of an indisposed guild member.
TEXT_CLSMIN250_00605_SEQ_01: One of your fellow miners has been taken ill, and Adalberta needs you to procure fifteen bottles of effervescent water in his stead. For your search, she recommends you head to Buscarron's Scar in Gridania's South Shroud. Once you have the required number, deliver them to the guildmaster.
TEXT_CLSMIN250_00605_SEQ_02:
Adalberta thanks you for your timely assistance. Owing to your efforts, the guild can now fulfill an urgent order from a major client. With the guildmaster's praise still ringing in your ears, you continue along your chosen path.

※The next miner quest will be available from Adalberta upon reaching level 30.
TEXT_CLSMIN300_00606_SEQ_00: Adalberta has a mind to assign you a challenging commission.
TEXT_CLSMIN300_00606_SEQ_01: You learn that the guild has received an order for a quantity of wyvern obsidian, an extremely rare mineral. Conscious of the difficulty you are like to encounter in procuring it, Adalberta has accepted another miner's offer of assistance, and would have the two of you work together. Seek out the miner in question─one Wide Gulley─and discuss the task at hand.
TEXT_CLSMIN300_00606_SEQ_02: To your dismay, Wide Gulley greets you with open hostility. He has no intention of cooperating with you, and instead proposes a contest to see who can procure superior-quality wyvern obsidian. In light of your relative inexperience, Wide Gulley offers you all the time you require, and even suggests that you consult the client, Hrodger, should you require more information on the mineral.
TEXT_CLSMIN300_00606_SEQ_03: Hrodger tells you that deposits of wyvern obsidian have previously been discovered around Thal's Respite. In addition, he reveals that Wide Gulley is in fact Vice Foreman Deep Canyon's son, and a miner of tremendous talent in his own right. Armed with this information, procure fifteen chunks of the purest wyvern obsidian you can find, and deliver them to Wide Gulley.
TEXT_CLSMIN300_00606_SEQ_04: After examining the fruits of your labors, Wide Gulley grudgingly concedes that your wyvern obsidian is purer than his own. Brooking no argument, he tells you that he will deliver your haul to Hrodger, and bids you report back to the guildmaster.
TEXT_CLSMIN300_00606_SEQ_05:
Adalberta is troubled to learn that Wide Gulley turned an already difficult task into a contest. Upon hearing that you bested him, however, her dismay swiftly gives way to astonishment. She proceeds to lavish you with praise, even confessing to a hint of envy, and encourages you to continue exceeding expectations.

※The next miner quest will be available from Adalberta upon reaching level 35.
TEXT_CLSGLD011_00608_SEQ_00: Jemime would have you reaffirm your desire to join the Goldsmiths' Guild.
TEXT_CLSGLD011_00608_SEQ_01: The receptionist bids you present yourself to Serendipity, the young lady in charge of the guild. Seek her out and show her your burning desire to become a goldsmith.
TEXT_CLSGLD011_00608_SEQ_02: Mistress Serendipity eagerly accepts you into the fold, and gifts you with a weathered chaser hammer. With the new tool of your trade in hand, speak to your guildmaster once more to begin your journey as a goldsmith.
TEXT_CLSGLD021_00610_SEQ_00: Serendipity would like to officially begin your training as a goldsmith.
TEXT_CLSGLD021_00610_SEQ_01: For your first lesson, the guildmaster bids you craft for her a single copper ingot. If needed, you may purchase the copper ore from Aistan, though wind shards must be obtained elsewhere.
TEXT_CLSGLD021_00610_SEQ_02:
Although Serendipity is pleased with your copper ingot, her assistant, Gigi, declares it unfit to bear night soil. Nevertheless, the guildmaster declares that you have talent, and that you should return once you have gained more experience.

※The next goldsmith quest will be available from Serendipity upon reaching level 5.
TEXT_CLSGLD050_00611_SEQ_00: Serendipity has a new task for you.
TEXT_CLSGLD050_00611_SEQ_01: Your next lesson requires that you craft three copper gorgets, for which you will need several copper ingots. Craft and deliver the gorgets to Serendipity.
TEXT_CLSGLD050_00611_SEQ_02:
Yet again your craftsmanship satisfies Serendipity, and yet again Gigi sees nothing worthy of praise. As a reward for your efforts, the guildmaster gives you a grinding wheel, which will aid you in your future goldsmithing endeavors.

※The next goldsmith quest will be available from Serendipity upon reaching level 10.
TEXT_CLSGLD101_00613_SEQ_00: Serendipity believes you are ready for a new kind of challenge.
TEXT_CLSGLD101_00613_SEQ_01: Serendipity has tasked you with your first official commission. Craft a dozen handfuls of copper rings and present them to her for inspection.
TEXT_CLSGLD101_00613_SEQ_02: In a surprising turn of events, Gigi compliments your craftsmanship, albeit in a tremendously condescending manner. Serendipity bids you deliver the copper rings to the client, a Sultansworn named Robert, who should be waiting just outside the Goldsmiths' Guild.
TEXT_CLSGLD101_00613_SEQ_03: Robert thanks you for the delivery, and states that the full payment will be delivered to the guild in short order. Relay his words to Serendipity.
TEXT_CLSGLD101_00613_SEQ_04:
Serendipity's eyes light up with joy upon hearing the Sultansworn's words. After regaining her composure, she suggests that you start accepting independent commissions by speaking with Eustace at the Quicksand, as a means of earning gil and building your reputation as a goldsmith.

※The next goldsmith quest will be available from Serendipity upon reaching level 15.
TEXT_CLSGLD150_00614_SEQ_00: Serendipity appears to be in great distress.
TEXT_CLSGLD150_00614_SEQ_01: The guildmaster abruptly recalls that she had another commission to assign you─once again for Robert of the Sultansworn. Craft a pair of fang earrings and a brass gorget and present them to Serendipity for inspection.
TEXT_CLSGLD150_00614_SEQ_02: Gigi somehow manages to praise your handiwork and deeply offend Serendipity. In any case, both the guildmaster and her assistant judge the items fit for delivery. Take them to Robert outside the Goldsmiths' Guild.
TEXT_CLSGLD150_00614_SEQ_03: Robert is surprised to learn that the goldsmith who prepared his order was in fact you, not Mistress Serendipity. He apologizes for the misunderstanding, and mentions that he will be keeping his eye on you from now on. Return to the guildmaster and tell her that the commission is complete.
TEXT_CLSGLD150_00614_SEQ_04:
While bemused at first, Serendipity quickly decides that Robert's mistake is proof of your tremendous growth as a goldsmith.

※The next goldsmith quest will be available from Serendipity upon reaching level 20.
TEXT_CLSGLD200_00615_SEQ_00: Serendipity would like to resume giving you proper lessons.
TEXT_CLSGLD200_00615_SEQ_01: Brushing aside the loss of her precious apple tart, the guildmaster decides to give you your first proper lesson since the past two commissions. Craft a staghorn staff, enhance it with a single materia of any type, then present it to Serendipity for inspection.
TEXT_CLSGLD200_00615_SEQ_02:
Though she is forced to correct Gigi's apparent misconceptions about materia, it appears both the guildmaster and her assistant approve of your latest creation.

※The next goldsmith quest will be available from Serendipity upon reaching level 25.
TEXT_CLSGLD250_00616_SEQ_00: Serendipity requires your assistance with a dire matter.
TEXT_CLSGLD250_00616_SEQ_01: The guildmaster needs your help to aid an ailing Gigi. Craft an ingot of high-quality silver and deliver it to Serendipity posthaste.
TEXT_CLSGLD250_00616_SEQ_02:
Serendipity explains that, while she can easily repair and replace most mammet components, the cores that contain a mammet's personality and memory are a completely different matter. Thankfully, the failing part is one she can reproduce, so the stalwart assistant should soon be back to normal.

※The next goldsmith quest will be available from Serendipity upon reaching level 30.
TEXT_CLSGLD300_00617_SEQ_00: Serendipity needs your help to resolve an unfortunate situation.
TEXT_CLSGLD300_00617_SEQ_01: A meeting between Serendipity and a traveling merchant was rudely interrupted by Gigi, who drove off the man with his usual scathing insults. In order to make amends with the merchant, Serendipity would like to gift him a pair of high-quality malachite earrings. Craft and present them to the guildmaster for inspection.
TEXT_CLSGLD300_00617_SEQ_02: The guildmaster is deeply impressed by the quality of your craftsmanship. Hopeful that the offended merchant will feel similarly, Serendipity asks you to track down Roroton in the Ruby Road Exchange and present the earrings to him.
TEXT_CLSGLD300_00617_SEQ_03: Roroton marks you as an exemplary artisan, and considers the events leading to your meeting to be a blessing in disguise. He bids you deliver his card and a message to Serendipity.
TEXT_CLSGLD300_00617_SEQ_04:
Serendipity is delighted by the tidings. She believes that the merchant was swayed by your gift for goldsmithing, and tells you to work hard in preparation for when Roroton requests your services once more.

※The next goldsmith quest will be available from Serendipity upon reaching level 35.
TEXT_CLSMIN350_00643_SEQ_00: Adalberta has an order she would like you to handle.
TEXT_CLSMIN350_00643_SEQ_01: Adalberta has asked you to obtain twenty raw amethysts. Confessing that the gemstones are not her specialty, she bids you speak with Wide Gulley to learn where they might be found.
TEXT_CLSMIN350_00643_SEQ_02: Wide Gulley obliges you with the information, but only because he is certain that you will fail at your task. Being careful to avoid the fearsome creatures in the area, make your way to Hopeseed Pond in the Central Shroud, and obtain twenty raw amethysts. Once you have the required quantity, present them to Wide Gulley.
TEXT_CLSMIN350_00643_SEQ_03:
Wide Gulley cannot hide his surprise that you were able to brave the dangers to procure the amethysts. To your credit, the man has come to see you as a rival, and expresses his intent to redouble his efforts. Keep working at your craft, that you might be prepared when the next contest inevitably comes.

※The next miner quest will be available from Adalberta upon reaching level 40.
TEXT_CLSMIN400_00644_SEQ_00: Adalberta would like to entrust you with a difficult task.
TEXT_CLSMIN400_00644_SEQ_01: You learn from Adalberta that Deep Canyon has placed an outrageous order for no fewer than twenty pieces of jade. It seems the precious stones can only be found naturally in Coerthas. Adalberta beseeches you to not do anything for which you are not prepared. In the meantime, however, you are told that Wide Gulley has something to discuss. Seek him out in the guild before making any rash decisions.
TEXT_CLSMIN400_00644_SEQ_02: Somewhat expectedly, Wide Gulley proposes another contest─the first to fulfill Deep Canyon's order wins. Make your way to Haldrath's March in Coerthas, and there obtain twenty pieces of jade. Once you have the required quantity, present them to Adalberta.
TEXT_CLSMIN400_00644_SEQ_03:
Delivering the jade to Adalberta, you learn to your surprise that you have won the contest by default. Wide Gulley was attacked by a monster and could not complete the order. While the guildmaster applauds your success, she cannot help but feel concerned for your recuperating comrade, who she says is deeply depressed.

※The next miner quest will be available from Adalberta upon reaching level 45.
TEXT_CLSMIN450_00645_SEQ_00: Adalberta has a personal favor to ask of you.
TEXT_CLSMIN450_00645_SEQ_01: Ever since losing to you in the latest contest, Wide Gulley has been taking on tasks like a man possessed. However, Adalberta suspects that more is driving him than simply the sting of defeat. Concerned for his health, she bids you speak with Wide Gulley in order to learn the truth of the matter.
TEXT_CLSMIN450_00645_SEQ_02: Wide Gulley reveals to you that his father has been tampering with official records in order to enhance his standing in the guild. Deeply ashamed, he has taken on a throng of tasks in the hopes of turning Deep Canyon's lies into truths. Unfortunately, he has bitten off more than he can chew, and begs you to fulfill an order in his stead. Make your way to Camp Bronze Lake in upper La Noscea, and obtain twenty chunks of electrum ore on your guildmate's behalf.
TEXT_CLSMIN450_00645_SEQ_03:
You have delivered the electrum ore to a grateful Wide Gulley, who goes on to compare himself to brass─pretty to behold, but worth little. Will the man ever be able to meet the high expectations he has of himself?

※The next miner quest will be available from Adalberta upon reaching level 50.
TEXT_CLSMIN500_00646_SEQ_00: Adalberta is gravely concerned for the fate of an old friend.
TEXT_CLSMIN500_00646_SEQ_01: The flustered Adalberta reveals to you that Wide Gulley has reported his father's abuse of power to the Concern's upper management. The guildmaster bids you speak with Wide Gulley and learn all you can of the situation, that she might help her old friend and mentor.
TEXT_CLSMIN500_00646_SEQ_02: Wide Gulley admits that he has filed an official complaint to the Concern, so ashamed he was of his father's actions. He suggests you speak with the accused in order to hear his side of the story.
TEXT_CLSMIN500_00646_SEQ_03: Deep Canyon reveals that his actions were fueled by the long-standing desire to bring down Adalberta for her betrayal years ago. Deliver this shocking revelation to your guildmaster.
TEXT_CLSMIN500_00646_SEQ_04: According to Adalberta, Deep Canyon's belief that she betrayed him is nothing but a misunderstanding. Loath to see him destroy his career due to this perceived slight, she bids you speak with Wide Gulley, and with him find a way to save his father.
TEXT_CLSMIN500_00646_SEQ_05: In order to prove that he is fit to remain vice foreman, Deep Canyon must demonstrate to the Concern that he still has the confidence of guild members. To this end, you must procure three chunks of darksteel ore, an extremely rare metal found only from unspoiled mineral deposits in Coerthas. You are warned that these deposits only appear during certain times of day. Use the technique Truth of Mountains to locate darksteel ore that appears in the Coerthas central highlands at 1:00 a.m. (Eorzea time), mine the required quantity, and return it to Adalberta as quickly as you are able.
TEXT_CLSMIN500_00646_SEQ_06: Owing to your intervention, Deep Canyon has been given a chance to redeem himself. With the matter now laid to rest, speak once more with the relieved Adalberta, who awaits you in the Miners' Guild.
TEXT_CLSMIN500_00646_SEQ_07:
Adalberta thanks you for the part you played in sparing Deep Canyon a fate of ignominy, and lavishes you with praise for your growth as a miner. She bids you go forth and practice your craft for the benefit of all. May your toils never go unrewarded!

※The next miner quest will be available from Adalberta once you have completed the main scenario quest “Before the Dawn.”
TEXT_CLSALC350_00647_SEQ_00: Guildmaster Severian wishes to assign you a “minor” task.
TEXT_CLSALC350_00647_SEQ_01: Although Severian has now accepted you as his assistant in truth, he feels the research for the ultimate expression of alchemy cannot continue until the constant flow of inconvenient guild tasks has been dammed. Speak with Deitrich, the guild's receptionist, and arrange for the guildmaster's official duties to be channeled elsewhere.
TEXT_CLSALC350_00647_SEQ_02: You learn from Deitrich that Severian's obsessive research began after the Calamity took the life of his one true love. Considering the growing disapproval surrounding the guildmaster's actions and concerned for the man's well-being, the receptionist is initially reluctant to grant your request. He eventually suggests, however, that providing one of the guild's valued patrons with a fine-quality vial of hi-ether will generate the goodwill necessary to avoid further obligations for a time. Return to Severian and tell him the good news.
TEXT_CLSALC350_00647_SEQ_03: After relaying Deitrich's suggestion, you find yourself assigned the task of creating an uncommonly potent vial of hi-ether. Deliver the completed concoction to Severian.
TEXT_CLSALC350_00647_SEQ_04:
You have delivered to Severian your remarkably efficacious hi-ether and earned the enthusiastic alchemist's glowing praise. With the threat of interruption to his research removed, the guildmaster states that he is ready to begin the final stage of experiments. The pinnacle of alchemy seems but a short climb away.

※The next alchemist quest will be available from Severian upon reaching level 40.
TEXT_CLSALC400_00648_SEQ_00: Guildmaster Severian appears beside himself with excitement.
TEXT_CLSALC400_00648_SEQ_01: Severian claims to have finally uncovered the recipe he needs to move forward with the ultimate alchemical process. Assist the eccentric alchemist with preparing the necessary ingredients by concocting three unusually potent hi-potions of strength.
TEXT_CLSALC400_00648_SEQ_02:
Your extraordinary vials of vigor have been received with Severian's customary enthusiasm. Though remaining somewhat vague as to the actual result he hopes to achieve with this ambitious alchemical undertaking, the guildmaster states that he is ready to begin the long and demanding process. There is little left to do but return to your studies while you await its completion...

※The next alchemist quest will be available from Severian upon reaching level 45.
TEXT_CLSALC450_00649_SEQ_00: Guildmaster Severian appears in frantic need of your assistance.
TEXT_CLSALC450_00649_SEQ_01: It seems that Severian's long-awaited alchemical process has failed to yield the expected results. Without offering an explanation, the frenzied alchemist demands you bring him a number of high-quality concoctions. Create three extraordinary mega-potions─one of intelligence, one of mind, and one of vitality─and deliver the completed substances to the guildmaster.
TEXT_CLSALC450_00649_SEQ_02:
You have delivered the three mega-potions to the agitated guildmaster. After inspecting your superb creations and regaining a measure of composure, Severian finally explains the reason behind his obsessive research─he means to resurrect W'nahja, the love he lost to the Calamity. With a new batch of components in hand, the determined alchemist returns to his workbench to begin a new attempt. Once more, you are helpless to do anything but await the results...

※The next alchemist quest will be available from Severian upon reaching level 50.
TEXT_CLSALC500_00650_SEQ_00: Guildmaster Severian appears to have isolated the missing element in his work.
TEXT_CLSALC500_00650_SEQ_01: Severian explains that his previous attempt to resurrect his lost love failed to take into account the necessity for a spiritual anchor. Speak with W'bulea in Pearl Lane, and ask if she might spare the guildmaster an object that W'nahja held dear.
TEXT_CLSALC500_00650_SEQ_02: W'bulea is unable─or unwilling─to give you any items that her sister might have treasured. Though thoroughly out of patience with Severian's experiments, she suggests visiting W'nahja's admirers to see if they can help you in your quest. Speak with adventurers in the Quicksand and merchants at the Ruby Road Exchange to learn of any objects that could suit the guildmaster's needs.
TEXT_CLSALC500_00650_SEQ_03: After speaking with W'nahja's admirers, you learn that the conjurer was fond of a certain wand. Recreate her high-quality budding rosewood wand and affix to it a grade three quicktongue materia, before delivering the weapon to Severian at the Alchemists' Guild.
TEXT_CLSALC500_00650_SEQ_04: With the final component of the process in place, Severian finally succeeds in resurrecting W'nahja. The reunion, however, is short-lived─after dispelling the guildmaster's lingering feelings of guilt, the conjurer fades into the aether. Speak with the guildmaster and learn what he intends to do now.
TEXT_CLSALC500_00650_SEQ_05:
Freed at last from his years-long obsession, the master alchemist urges you to join him in his continuing exploration of the limitless realm of alchemy.

※The next alchemist quest will be available from Severian once you have completed the main scenario quest “Before the Dawn.”
TEXT_CLSWVR350_00651_SEQ_00: Redolent Rose has received another commission from a regular customer.
TEXT_CLSWVR350_00651_SEQ_01: Wawarukka has requested your services as a weaver once more. Speak with him on Onyx Lane to learn more about the commission.
TEXT_CLSWVR350_00651_SEQ_02: The miner explains that his previous attempt to woo Kokomo ended in failure. However, he refuses to give up, and intends to approach her wearing a new ensemble. He bids you prepare a high-quality linen shirt for this purpose. Craft the item as requested and deliver it to Redolent Rose.
TEXT_CLSWVR350_00651_SEQ_03:
To compensate for his ignorance of Ul'dahn fashion, Wawarukka enlisted the help of his friends when preparing his new outfit. Alas, the end result is a veritable hodgepodge of conflicting designs, and your linen shirt is no exception. Unable to stop the miner yet again, Redolent Rose falls to his knees and cries out in despair, only to rise to his feet moments later and excuse himself. Though it is likely a futile effort, you can only assume he wishes to pretend that the preceding events simply never occurred...

※The next weaver quest will be available from Redolent Rose upon reaching level 40.
TEXT_CLSWVR400_00652_SEQ_00: Redolent Rose has a commission for you, as well as a private request.
TEXT_CLSWVR400_00652_SEQ_01: Redolent Rose has tasked you with a commission for Kokomo, the object of Wawarukka's affections. Seeing an opportunity, he has also asked you to subtly inquire as to her feelings towards the miner. Speak with Kokomo at the Gold Court to learn more of the commission and of her heart.
TEXT_CLSWVR400_00652_SEQ_02: Kokomo knows full well who Wawarukka is, and appears to harbor no ill will towards him. As for the commission, she has asked you to craft a pair of quality woolen tights. Prepare the item as requested and deliver it to Redolent Rose.
TEXT_CLSWVR400_00652_SEQ_03:
During the fitting, Kokomo unintentionally reveals that she has feelings for her secret admirer. Now knowing that Wawarukka's efforts will not be in vain, the guildmaster ponders how he can prevent Wawarukka from botching another attempt to win the young woman's heart.

※The next weaver quest will be available from Redolent Rose upon reaching level 45.
TEXT_CLSWVR450_00653_SEQ_00: Redolent Rose appears to be in high spirits.
TEXT_CLSWVR450_00653_SEQ_01: Redolent Rose has decided that the best way to help Wawarukka is to ignore the miner's terrible taste in clothing. To that end, he has taken the liberty of changing Wawarukka's commission. Before you can proceed, you must first obtain approval from the miner. Speak with Wawarukka and obtain his permission.
TEXT_CLSWVR450_00653_SEQ_02: While surprised by the guildmaster's proposal, Wawarukka is willing to accept it, acknowledging that his ignorance of fashion has been the cause of his previous failures. Craft a woolen beret, gown, and gaskins of the highest quality and present them to Redolent Rose.
TEXT_CLSWVR450_00653_SEQ_03:
During the fitting, a depressed Wawarukka reveals that he saw Kokomo in the company of a wealthy suitor not long ago. Convinced that all is lost, he flees the guild in a fit of despair, proclaiming himself unworthy of Kokomo's affections. Resigned, Redolent Rose states that if Wawarukka is determined to give up, then there is nothing either of you can do to help.

※The next weaver quest will be available from Redolent Rose upon reaching level 50.
TEXT_CLSWVR500_00654_SEQ_00: Redolent Rose is furrowing his brow most furiously.
TEXT_CLSWVR500_00654_SEQ_01: Mamajaru, the wealthy Lalafell for whom you once crafted an acton, intends to propose to Kokomo. Upon learning of this, Wawarukka rushes to the guild, exclaiming that he must tell the girl how he feels before it's too late. To that end, he begs you and Redolent Rose for a set of fine garments so he can make the best possible impression. Craft and deliver a high-quality pair of patrician's bottoms, a high-quality patrician's wedge cap, and a high-quality patrician's coatee to Redolent Rose─the guildmaster will prepare the other pieces.
TEXT_CLSWVR500_00654_SEQ_02: Wawarukka is overjoyed by the ensemble you and the guildmaster have prepared. However, it may all be for naught─Kokomo is currently in the company of Mamajaru, and the guildmaster suspects that the proposal may be imminent. Wawarukka quickly departs for the Gold Court to see Kokomo, and Redolent Rose bids you follow to observe what transpires.
TEXT_CLSWVR500_00654_SEQ_03: Though hesitant at first, Wawarukka rushes to Kokomo's side when Mamajaru attempts to strike her in a fit of anger. Filled with newfound confidence, he confronts the wealthy heir, who then flees. Now alone, Wawarukka and Kokomo stare deep into each other's eyes and begin a long-overdue conversation. Having observed that things are proceeding smoothly, you quietly excuse yourself. Return to the Weavers' Guild and tell Redolent Rose what you saw.
TEXT_CLSWVR500_00654_SEQ_04:
Upon hearing your account, Redolent Rose cannot help but laugh. Though clearly pleased to have helped the two young Lalafells, he asserts that he has acted only as a professional serving his clients. The future of Wawarukka and Kokomo's relationship is hardly certain, but he nevertheless compliments you on a job well done.

※The next weaver quest will be available from Redolent Rose once you have completed the main scenario quest “Before the Dawn.”
TEXT_CLSGLD350_00655_SEQ_00: Serendipity is quite pleased to see you.
TEXT_CLSGLD350_00655_SEQ_01: Roroton, the merchant for whom you previously crafted a pair of malachite earrings, has commissioned you to make a fire brand of peerless quality. Craft the item to the best of your ability and present it to Serendipity for inspection.
TEXT_CLSGLD350_00655_SEQ_02:
As usual, Gigi assists with the evaluation of your work. However, in an unusual turn of events, your fire brand appears to trigger bizarre pyromaniac tendencies hidden deep within the mammet's soul. Nevertheless, Serendipity assures you that there is no need for concern, and that she will see that Roroton receives his order without incident.

※The next goldsmith quest will be available from Serendipity upon reaching level 40.
TEXT_CLSGLD400_00656_SEQ_00: Serendipity has another commission for you.
TEXT_CLSGLD400_00656_SEQ_01: Once again, Roroton has decided to request your services by name. Craft a high-quality horn staff and present it to Serendipity for inspection.
TEXT_CLSGLD400_00656_SEQ_02: Gigi and Serendipity both agree that your growth as a goldsmith is undeniable. Since you have not spoken with Roroton in some time, Serendipity suggests that you deliver the staff in person. Seek out the merchant at the Ruby Road Exchange in the Steps of Nald.
TEXT_CLSGLD400_00656_SEQ_03: Roroton is happy to see you again, and is surprised that you have already finished the staff. Your conversation soon turns to the topic of the Jade Fox, a legendary thief and master of disguise rumored to have come to Ul'dah. Roroton urges you and your guildmates to be careful, as the Jade Fox is known to have a penchant for fine jewelry. Report to Serendipity at the Goldsmiths' Guild and inform her that the commission is complete.
TEXT_CLSGLD400_00656_SEQ_04:
Serendipity congratulates you on another successful assignment, and echoes Roroton's warning about the Jade Fox. However, she states that you need not worry about any commissions made through the Goldsmiths' Guild, as she will personally scrutinize each and every customer. Whether or not her confidence is justified remains to be seen...

※The next goldsmith quest will be available from Serendipity upon reaching level 45.
TEXT_CLSGLD450_00657_SEQ_00: Serendipity is in desperate need of your assistance.
TEXT_CLSGLD450_00657_SEQ_01: The guild is awash with commissions on account of the upcoming gala to celebrate the sultana's nameday. Serendipity has asked you to lend a hand by crafting three electrum circlets of the highest quality possible─one with amber, one with spinel, and one with zircon. Prepare the items as requested and present them to the guildmaster for inspection.
TEXT_CLSGLD450_00657_SEQ_02: The guildmaster approves of your circlets and bids you deliver them to Roroton, but not before speaking with Robert, who should be returning to speak with you any moment. Search for him outside the Goldsmiths' Guild and see what he has to say.
TEXT_CLSGLD450_00657_SEQ_03: Robert reveals to you that the Jade Fox may be plotting to infiltrate the nameday festivities and rob the guests in attendance. To prevent this, the Sultansworn have been discreetly investigating the invited guests to determine if one might be the legendary thief. To your surprise, it seems that Roroton has become a prime suspect. Whatever the truth may be, you have a commission to complete. Deliver the circlets to Roroton at the Ruby Road Exchange.
TEXT_CLSGLD450_00657_SEQ_04: Unable to resist the temptation, you inquire as to Roroton's true motives for coming to Ul'dah. He confides in you that he is more of an altruist than a businessman, and that his purpose in life is to share the beauty of fine art with others. Return to the Goldsmiths' Guild and report to Serendipity.
TEXT_CLSGLD450_00657_SEQ_05:
Serendipity has also learned of the rumors regarding the Jade Fox and the nameday celebration. Disgusted that a thief would consider ruining what should be a happy occasion, she hopes that Robert catches the fiend and personally teaches him a lesson.

※The next goldsmith quest will be available from Serendipity upon reaching level 50.
TEXT_CLSGLD500_00658_SEQ_00: Serendipity appears to be extremely tired. Perhaps you should inquire as to why.
TEXT_CLSGLD500_00658_SEQ_01: A sleep-deprived Serendipity has tasked you with a very important commission, once again for the merchant Roroton. As an attendee to the sultana's nameday celebration, he wishes to present a gift to Her Grace. If his gift meets with her favor, he will rise to even greater prominence in Ul'dahn society. You must craft a high-quality black pearl ring, and then you must meld to it a grade three piety materia. When finished, present the ring to Serendipity.
TEXT_CLSGLD500_00658_SEQ_02: After Serendipity verifies that you have completed the ring, she summons Roroton to the guild. However, your meeting takes a dramatic turn when Robert bursts in and accuses the merchant of being the Jade Fox. He takes Roroton into custody and departs the guild, though not before seizing your black pearl ring as evidence. Speak with Serendipity and see what she thinks of this unexpected development.
TEXT_CLSGLD500_00658_SEQ_03: Serendipity suddenly realizes that Gigi is nowhere to be found, and begs you to help her find him. She recalls that he was muttering something about Pearl Lane, and suggests that you begin the search for the missing mammet there.
TEXT_CLSGLD500_00658_SEQ_04: You and Serendipity find Gigi in Pearl Lane, along with Robert and Roroton. Gigi accuses the Sultansworn of being an impostor, a claim which Robert does not deny. His identity revealed, the Jade Fox attempts to hold Roroton hostage, but the merchant and mammet manage to subdue the thief. Observing that Gigi has been severely damaged in the struggle, you heroically attempt to repair him by jamming your ring inside him, despite having absolutely no knowledge of mammet construction and no reason to believe it would make a difference. Inexplicably, your efforts appear to meet with some success, as the mammet reactivates and subsequently states how much it dislikes your most recent creation. Return to the guild and discuss all that has transpired with Serendipity.
TEXT_CLSGLD500_00658_SEQ_05:
Serendipity explains that your reckless attempt to repair Gigi with your black pearl ring invoked such overwhelming disgust that the mammet, through sheer strength of will, overcame its injuries. She also reveals that Gigi's original name is Mnejing, and that as the first mammet ever built, he served as the basis for all future designs. However, she decides not to divulge this information to the mammet, as it would only serve to inflate his ego even more. Although she appreciates your good intentions, Serendipity politely requests that you not tamper with a mammet's internal mechanisms again─at least until you have gained a cursory knowledge of their workings.

※The next goldsmith quest will be available from Serendipity once you have completed the main scenario quest “Before the Dawn.”
TEXT_CLSPGL101_00698_SEQ_00: Guildmaster Hamon wishes you to build upon your knowledge of combinations.
TEXT_CLSPGL101_00698_SEQ_01: Hamon has set up five dummies outside the guild, along the Merchant Strip. By way of a warm-up for your lesson, he bids you deal each a Bootshine combo.
TEXT_CLSPGL101_00698_SEQ_02: You have struck all five wooden dummies in the prescribed fashion, much to the delight of the cheering onlookers. Report back to Hamon at the Pugilists' Guild.
TEXT_CLSPGL101_00698_SEQ_03: Hamon teaches you an elementary pugilist combo: Bootshine, True Strike, then Snap Punch. To have you practice this rudimentary-yet-essential combination, the guildmaster bids you unleash Snap Punch three times upon the Qiqirn of the Rat's Nest in central Thanalan.
TEXT_CLSPGL101_00698_SEQ_04: You have succeeded in performing Snap Punch three times on the Qiqirn. Report your success to Hamon at the Pugilists' Guild.
TEXT_CLSPGL101_00698_SEQ_05:
Upon your return to the guild, Hamon expresses his delight at your swift progress. At the same time, however, he is concerned for Chuchuto, who he says has been in a rut ever since her best friend and rival, Rurukuta, disappeared. For now, continue to train hard and improve, that Chuchuto might regain her motivation.

※The next pugilist quest will be available from Hamon upon reaching level 15.
TEXT_JOBWAR300_01049_SEQ_00: Axemaster Wyrnzoen needs an adventurer he can trust.
TEXT_JOBWAR300_01049_SEQ_01: An old comrade of Wyrnzoen's, now in the employ of Master Gegeruju of Costa del Sol, has sent an urgent call for reinforcements, and the axemaster believes you to be the only marauder up to the task. Travel to Costa del Sol and rendezvous with your guildmate Solkwyb.
TEXT_JOBWAR300_01049_SEQ_02: Solkwyb explains that Costa del Sol has been beset by a fearsome horde of turtles, and that the creatures seem to be originating from the northern shore. Investigate any possible cause of the beasts' burgeoning numbers.
TEXT_JOBWAR300_01049_SEQ_03: With the assistance of a formidable Roegadyn calling himself Curious Gorge, you have driven back the turtle horde that appeared to have been summoned forth by a suspicious figure. Speak to your guildmate Solkwyb, who appears unnerved by what she has seen.
