He has come seeking a strong fish with which to slay a giant toad as part of a rite of passage paramount to his people─and Donuhanu is all too eager to help. Marveling at the ability of fate to bring kindred souls together, you follow them back to Fish Fancies Donuhanu.
TEXT_KINGLA501_04996_SEQ_03: Distracted from his shop's dim prospects for the moment, Donuhanu plunges himself into the task at hand, wracking his brain for the strongest fish he can come up with. You stand by, eager for him to point you in a direction, because the waters of Tural are teeming with fish, and you are ready to cast your line.
TEXT_KINGLA502_04997_SEQ_01:
Donuhanu has asked that you procure king puffers for Pashenine's rite of passage.

King puffers can be fished from High Tide Harbor using crimson lugworms as bait.

※Minimum collectability rating for this delivery is 47. Delivering items with a rating of 110 or more will earn greater rewards.
TEXT_KINGLA502_04997_SEQ_02: You deliver the king puffers to Donuhanu. Enjoy some Turali fishing until Pashenine returns with his next request.
TEXT_KINGLA503_04998_SEQ_00: Just like you, Donuhanu is awaiting Pashenine's return.
TEXT_KINGLA503_04998_SEQ_01:
Donuhanu has asked that you procure Yok Huy plecos for Pashenine's rite of passage.

Yok Huy plecos can be fished from waters Hanu using honeybees as bait.

※Minimum collectability rating for this delivery is 165. Delivering items with a rating of 388 or more will earn greater rewards.
TEXT_KINGLA503_04998_SEQ_02: You deliver the Yok Huy plecos to Donuhanu. As new interest in unusual catches begins to take root, continue to provide support to Fish Fancies Donuhanu.
TEXT_KINGLA504_04999_SEQ_00: Donuhanu hums happily as he contemplates unusual fish.
TEXT_KINGLA504_04999_SEQ_01:
Donuhanu has asked that you procure Qor pirarucu for Pashenine's rite of passage.

Qor pirarucu can be fished from Karvarhur the First using honeybees as bait.

※Minimum collectability rating for this delivery is 433. Delivering items with a rating of 1017 or more will earn greater rewards.
TEXT_KINGLA504_04999_SEQ_02: You deliver Qor pirarucu to Donuhanu. Pashenine will be ready to undertake his rite of passage once he has finished digesting─so be sure to support him when the time comes.
TEXT_KINGLA505_05000_SEQ_01: Having thoroughly digested his most recent fish, Pashenine sets out to challenge his rite of passage. He must face his trials alone, but he would like you and Donuhanu to join him at his final stop in Uyuyub' so he can show you the results in person.
TEXT_KINGLA505_05000_SEQ_02: You and Donuhanu arrive ahead of Pashenine, but he soon appears bearing gargantuan corpses, all slain by the power of phantasmic fish. Donuhanu presumes celebrations are in order, but Pashenine reveals that his most difficult challenge still lies ahead. He must slay a carnivorous tree, more lethal than all three defeated marks combined. His budding confidence is shaken in the face of this formidable foe, but Donuhanu is not willing to let the Whalaqee's journey end just yet. For every enemy, there is a fish that might defeat it, and the Hanuhanu seems certain that the cenotes of the Ja Tiika Heartland are home to the deadly fish that Pashenine needs. Donuhanu dashes off to catch it himself, which is by any standards, a dangerous lapse in judgment. You hurry to Yak T'el to fish your feathered friend out of trouble.
TEXT_KINGLA505_05000_SEQ_03: Perhaps predictably, Donuhanu has injured himself in his ill-advised fishing endeavor. It is up to you to fish out the shark that has been terrorizing the waters of Bitterbark Cenote, and deliver it to the wheezing fishmonger.
TEXT_KINGLA505_05000_SEQ_04: In a display of peerless fishing prowess, you snag the cenote shark and haul it to dry land. Donuhanu praises your skill before realizing that the comfort of his own shop is preferable to the wild outdoors, so it's back to the Fancies you go.
TEXT_KINGLA505_05000_SEQ_05: Happily settled back at the Fancies, Donuhanu explains the strengths of the cenote shark you so deftly reeled in. Pashenine, however, has something else on his mind. He asks the Hanuhanu fishmonger why he has risked wit and wing to help realize the dream of a fledgling mage. Feathers ruffling in embarrassment, Donuhanu explains that Pashenine's arrival caused him to rethink his attitude towards his favorite fish. By gaining a thorough understanding of their qualities, he might yet prevail upon others to see their value, and thus make Fish Fancies Donuhanu a place to honor all odd fish. While both your friends have dreams to work toward, the path is still long─and you will be with them the entire way, fishing pole at the ready...
TEXT_KINGLA506_05001_SEQ_00: The fishmonger's feathers are fluffed in anticipation of Pashenine's return.
TEXT_KINGLA506_05001_SEQ_01:
Donuhanu has asked that you procure raging Hanuheads to help Pashenine regain his strength.

Raging Hanuheads can be fished from Eastbound Zorgor using dragonflies as bait.

※Minimum collectability rating for this delivery is 228. Delivering items with a rating of 535 or more will earn greater rewards.
TEXT_KINGLA506_05001_SEQ_02: You deliver raging Hanuheads to Donuhanu. Replenished of fighting spirit, Pashenine is now ready to attempt his trial again and fulfill his rite of passage. Stand by your fish-loving friends till the end!
TEXT_KINGLA507_05002_SEQ_00: You've never seen Donuhanu in such a state of concentration.
TEXT_KINGLA507_05002_SEQ_01: After some discussion, you realize that only a fish endowed with arcane strength will be able to defeat Pashenine's beastly tree. To this end, Donuhanu sends you to the outskirts in Heritage Found to search for lightning-aspected fish.
TEXT_KINGLA507_05002_SEQ_02:
The locals of Heritage Found recommend catching a fulmisturgeon for Pashenine's final challenge.

Fulmisturgeons can be fished from the submerged skyline using a popper lure as bait.
TEXT_KINGLA507_05002_SEQ_03:
You deliver the fulmisturgeon to Donuhanu. The time has come for Pashenine to partake of your offering and test his skills of piscatory manipulation against the dreaded carnivorous tree...

You bear witness to a display of literally and proverbially shocking fish combat. Although panting with exertion, Pashenine stands triumphant above his foe, rendered to broken bark by a brutal fulmisturgeon. In a bittersweet farewell, you part ways with your Whalaqee friend and travel back to Tuliyollal.
TEXT_KINGLA507_05002_SEQ_04: Donuhanu and Pashenine were able to bring new hope to each other's dreams, and you were able to bring lots of fish to everyone. While the unforgettable time you spent at Fish Fancies Donuhanu is behind you, the waters of Tural promise even greater delights to the fisher who brings patience and planning to  craft. Venture forth and discover all the strange and delightful friends that lurk just beneath the surface!
TEXT_KINGBZ001_05188_SEQ_00: Rral Majun has new tidings about an old adversary.
TEXT_KINGBZ001_05188_SEQ_01: While the Passage of the Unbound has been dealt a grievous blow, apparently the organization lives on, for Rral Majun and Br'uk Evu inform you that their founder Apyaahi seeks new leaders. The pair implore you to feign interest in joining her cause so you might find a way to bring her to justice. Knowing that her funds are based in Ul'dah, they bid you travel there and ask around to see if her agents have been sighted among the dusty streets.
TEXT_KINGBZ001_05188_SEQ_02: Your conversations with Ul'dah's citizenry reveal that a strange man has been lurking around the city and attempting to recruit disgruntled individuals. He was last sighted near the market board and may approach if you appear sufficiently angered by your circumstances.
TEXT_KINGBZ001_05188_SEQ_03: As expected, your bout of anger summons a sketchy man, who invites you to the Passage of the Unbound. After you express a desire to become one of their leaders, he gives you a handbill and instructs you to give it to an agent waiting in the Gold Court. There you will undergo an audition, but as of yet you know not what it entails.
TEXT_KINGBZ001_05188_SEQ_04: You find the agent waiting in front of a nondescript door, and his brusque attitude lightens after you give him the handbill. He invites you into the audience hall.
TEXT_KINGBZ001_05188_SEQ_05: Once inside the audience chamber, you find yourself before three judges, each more eccentric than the last. After a series of questions sensible and nonsensical both, they announce that you have passed their audition with flying colors. They encourage you to speak with the agent outside to receive your next set of instructions.
TEXT_KINGBZ001_05188_SEQ_06: The agent congratulates you on your success, but warns that the next step will be even more trying than the last. Once your heart is ready, he will tell you where you must go.
TEXT_KINGBZ002_05189_SEQ_00: The Unbound agent is ready to share your next destination.
TEXT_KINGBZ002_05189_SEQ_01: Luckily, the Unbound agent informs you that the next test is your last, and will be conducted by Apyaahi herself. However, it seems a flight of fancy has taken her to the Sagolii Desert, so it is there that you must seek her out to undertake your final trial.
TEXT_KINGBZ002_05189_SEQ_02: You cast your gaze across the sand dunes and are alarmed by the disturbing sight of Apyaahi seemingly taming a staggering sand worm. You approach the solitary Viera, and when you explain your purpose, she readily accepts your petition for leadership. Apparently the trial is to be held in the middle of the desert.
TEXT_KINGBZ002_05189_SEQ_03: Apyaahi questions you on your motivations for wanting to join her, and shares with you the desire for freedom that caused her to form the Passage of the Unbound. She soon asks you to follow her deeper into the desert, but warns you to watch for any hungry beasts.
TEXT_KINGBZ002_05189_SEQ_04: As you traverse the wastes, you see Apyaahi being accosted by a trio of sandrakes. She takes this opportunity to hold your practical exam, and you handily beat the beasts into submission. Apyaahi gazes at you with a look of appraisal.
TEXT_KINGBZ002_05189_SEQ_05: It seems your might has met with Apyaahi's approval. She beckons you to follow her further─hopefully you will not attract the attention of any more hungry creatures.
TEXT_KINGBZ002_05189_SEQ_06: At the summit of a tall dune, you and Apyaahi gaze upon the starry sky. After unceremoniously revealing that you have passed the final trial, she tells you about the search for freedom that led her to Tural and the Yok Huy spirit who gave her the treasure she wields. She then welcomes you as one of her leaders with a pose of dubious meaning, and spares you a moment to appreciate the weight of your grand achievement.
TEXT_KINGBZ002_05189_SEQ_07: Apyaahi instructs you to master the pose she performed and once again welcomes you into the Passage of the Unbound. With your induction complete, you draw one step closer to finding out what Apyaahi has in store for the world.
TEXT_KINGBZ003_05190_SEQ_00: You can sense a plot forming behind Apyaahi's mischievous eyes.
TEXT_KINGBZ003_05190_SEQ_01: Apyaahi wastes no time in determining her next course of action: overthrowing Tuliyollal to free Tural from the tyranny of nationhood. With your deception finally having borne fruit, you rush to Xbalyav Ty'e to share these grave tidings with Rral Majun.
TEXT_KINGBZ003_05190_SEQ_02: Troubled yet unsurprised by your news, Rral Majun and Br'uk Evu have tidings of their own to share: a familiar group of allies has but recently arrived in the city. As if summoned by this remark, your five companions during the search for the treasures walk into Xbalyav Ty'e. Apparently, they just returned from following a suspicious group from Tuliyollal to Shaaloani, and surmise that they may very well be the enforcers Apyaahi intends for you to meet. Ceetol Ja suggests splitting up, with her group going to Shaaloani to find out the details of Apyaahi's plan, and the other working to uncover the secrets of her treasure. Kuiyki asks to join her on her trek to Shaaloani, and apparently has a plan that will make the mission easier─which of course, involves you.
TEXT_KINGBZ003_05190_SEQ_03: Kuiyki reveals that she has the Dreamweave Cocoon with her, which will allow you to mimic Apyaahi's form and demand information from her minions. With your plan settled, the three of you depart to Hhusatahwi.
TEXT_KINGBZ003_05190_SEQ_04:
At the saloon in Hhusatahwi, Kuiyki gives you the Dreamweave Cocoon, and instructs you to imagine Apyaahi's features. You close your eyes and concentrate, and when you open them, you look down to see you've successfully taken on the form of the vixen Viera. Putting on your best impression of a whimsical villainess, you enter the saloon and approach the shady-looking men.

※If the transfiguration should fade, speak with Kuiyki again to be changed back into Apyaahi.
TEXT_KINGBZ003_05190_SEQ_05: Despite your impeccable disguise, the Unbound enforcer meets you with suspicion. Perhaps a sufficiently liberated pose will convince him of who you are─or who you are pretending to be, at least.
TEXT_KINGBZ003_05190_SEQ_06: Convinced by your mastery of the pose, the henchmen eagerly discuss Apyaahi's plan to attack the city of Tuliyollal. Eventually, they mention something about how she plans to build an army, but before they can elucidate further, Ceetol Ja calls you by linkshell and informs you that the real Apyaahi is soon to enter the saloon. You quickly change back into your original form and meet the Viera downstairs, who seems ready to enact her plot at any moment. Apyaahi goes to meet her cohorts, while you rush to Ceetol Ja to share your findings.
TEXT_KINGBZ003_05190_SEQ_07: Relieved that you were able to extract information from the enforcers before Apyaahi interrupted you, Ceetol Ja tells you that Tentoawa and the others have but recently arrived, and can be found out of sight some distance from the aetheryte.
TEXT_KINGBZ003_05190_SEQ_08: After everyone present exchanges information, the group surmises that Apyaahi's treasure can exert some kind of control over wild beasts. Tentoawa suggests that your best tactic will be to cut off her forces at Zorgor the Boundless, and volunteers to remain in the town to keep watch over her movements. You travel to Tuliyollal to share these new developments with Rral Majun.
TEXT_KINGBZ003_05190_SEQ_09: Though news of a potential army marching towards Tuliyollal unsettles Rral Majun, she is quick to regain her composure, vowing to inform the Landsguard of the coming threat. You steel yourself for the battle ahead, knowing that the very foundation of order in Tural is at stake.
TEXT_KINGBZ004_05191_SEQ_00: Rral Majun has a nervous look in her eyes.
TEXT_KINGBZ004_05191_SEQ_01: Tentoawa contacts you on linkpearl to inform you that Apyaahi and her cohorts are leaving Hhusatahwi. With your weapon at the ready, you make your way to the gates of Tuliyollal to rendezvous with your allies.
TEXT_KINGBZ004_05191_SEQ_02: As expected, Apyaahi approaches Tuliyollal in force, and after a fierce battle against all manner of beasts, you finally best the architect of the Passage of the Unbound. With your enemy's bag of tricks finally empty, you move to apprehend the villainess.
TEXT_KINGBZ004_05191_SEQ_03: As you approach, Apyaahi attempts to use the treasure's power one last time, but a well-placed arrow from Kuiyki destroys the object, leaving Apyaahi defenseless at last. The Viera does not resist as the Landsguard take her into custody, but she seems confident that her organization will live on. The truth of that remains to be seen, but for now, you are free to celebrate a hard-fought victory with your allies.
TEXT_KINGBZ004_05191_SEQ_04: Your allies express their joy and relief that the Passage of the Unbound have been stopped at last. Buoyed by the feeling of victory, you and your comrades return to Tuliyollal to apprise Rral Majun of what transpired.
TEXT_KINGBZ004_05191_SEQ_05: News of your triumph has already traveled to Xbalyav Ty'e, it seems, and Rral Majun informs you that the creatures you fought were in fact made from many small fungi. With the final mystery of Apyaahi's treasure revealed, the time for farewells is nigh, and your companions gather on the beach to share parting words with you.
TEXT_KINGBZ004_05191_SEQ_06: Tentoawa has managed to wean his village away from dependence on the Cradle of the Sleepless and now enjoys restful nights. He works to build solidarity among his fellows so that they can all contribute to their home's safety. Heartened by his story, you turn to Loashkana to see how she fares.
TEXT_KINGBZ004_05191_SEQ_07: As with Tentoawa before her, Loashkana and her people have also worked to live without depending on their treasure by building up their natural resistance to various toxins. Although it is a slow process of trial and error, she seems hopeful that they will reach their goal eventually. With your conversation at an end, you turn to speak with Kuiyki.
TEXT_KINGBZ004_05191_SEQ_08: Kuiyki is resolute in becoming a hunter worthy of her mentor's legacy, and asks you to look forward to hearing of her exploits in the future. Hopeful that you will, you turn to Ceetol Ja, who still seems excited by the day's proceedings.
TEXT_KINGBZ004_05191_SEQ_09: Ceetol Ja tells you that she received word from Kaqool Ja, who will soon be released from imprisonment and plans to visit her village. She hopes that the mercenary can find a permanent home with her people, and looks forward to potentially visiting Tuliyollal more often. With one more companion left to say your good-byes to, you turn to Tepeke.
TEXT_KINGBZ004_05191_SEQ_10: Tepeke is confident that her people can eventually learn to use the Perch of the Apex as a tool, instead of viewing it as something to be feared. Thoroughly encouraged that your companions seem to be on bright paths, the time has sadly come to part ways, and so you make ready to return to Br'uk Evu and Rral Majun.
TEXT_KINGBZ004_05191_SEQ_11: Your companions each go their separate ways, and with the saga of the treasures concluded, you sit down to enjoy a quiet moment with Br'uk Evu and Rral Majun. That is, until a group of loutish customers sit at an adjacent table, talking loudly about their plans to carry on Apyaahi's ideals. Not one to make the same mistake twice, Rral Majun wastes no time calling upon nearby Landsguard, who move to apprehend the pinheaded patrons. Sensing the end closing in, the group makes a hasty retreat, and the Landsguard follow in pursuit. As they run in an endless circle, you wonder whether you really have seen the last of the Passage of the Unbound...
